books.name: Adam Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Adam Alaihis Salam ki kahani paidaish ke bajaye Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se unki takhleeq se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Mitti se takhleeq
pages.roman:
Insaan ki ibtida Allah Ta'ala ki takhleeq se hui. Allah Ta'ala ne Adam Alaihis Salam ko mitti se paida kiya. Quran is takhleeq ko Allah Ta'ala ki qudrat ki nishani ke taur par bayan karta hai.

Adam Alaihis Salam ki kahani aam insani paidaish se shuru nahi hoti. Unhein Allah Ta'ala ne paida kiya, aur unki zindagi ke aage ke waqiat mein ilm, zimmedari aur hidayat ki ahmiyat samne aati hai.

Quran is aaghaz ko Allah Ta'ala ki qudrat se jorta hai. Insaan ki takhleeq kisi apni kamai hui bartari ka nateeja nahi thi; Adam Alaihis Salam ko wajood dene wala Allah Ta'ala tha. Aage isi insaan ko ilm aur zimmedari di gayi.
pages.english:
Human life begins with Allah’s creation. Allah created Adam Alaihis Salam from dust; the Quran presents this as a sign of His power.

This is not an account of an ordinary human birth. The events that follow introduce knowledge, responsibility and guidance.

The Quran places this beginning within Allah's power to create. Adam Alaihis Salam did not bring himself into existence. The account then turns from creation to the knowledge and responsibility Allah gave him.
pages.noteRoman: Is ki tareekh ya jagah ki apni taraf se tafseel nahi jori gayi.

pages.title: Zameen par zimmedari
pages.roman:
Allah Ta'ala ne farishton ko zameen mein ek khalifah banane ki khabar di. Farishton ne sawal kiya; Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ke woh jaanta hai jo woh nahi jaante.

Farishton ne zameen mein fasad aur khoon-rezi ka sawal kiya, aur Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya ke woh janta hai jo woh nahi jante. Is jawab ke baad waqia Adam Alaihis Salam ko sikhaye jane wale ilm ki taraf barhta hai.
pages.english:
Allah told the angels that He would place a successor on earth. He knew what they did not know.

The angels asked about corruption and bloodshed on earth. Allah knew what they did not know. The narrative then shows a gift of knowledge that makes the responsibility given to Adam Alaihis Salam clearer.

pages.title: Ilm ki nemat
pages.roman:
Zameen mein khalifah ke zikr ke saath Quran Adam Alaihis Salam ko diye gaye ilm ka waqia sunata hai. Allah Ta'ala ne unhein naam sikhaye aur phir un cheezon ko farishton ke samne pesh kiya.

Farishton ne apne ilm ki had tasleem ki: unke paas wahi ilm tha jo Allah Ta'ala ne unhein sikhaya tha. Adam Alaihis Salam ne Allah Ta'ala ke sikhaye hue naam bataye. Yeh ilm unki apni quwwat ka dawa nahi, unke Rabb ki ata thi.

Jab farishte un naamon ko bayan na kar sake to unhon ne apne ilm ki hadd ka iqrar kiya. Phir Adam Alaihis Salam ne Allah Ta'ala ke sikhaye hue naam bataye. Yeh ilm bhi Allah Ta'ala ki ata tha, apne Rabb se be-niyaz hone ki wajah nahi.
pages.english:
Alongside the account of responsibility on earth, the Quran describes the knowledge Allah gave Adam Alaihis Salam. Allah taught him the names and presented the things to the angels.

The angels acknowledged that they knew only what Allah had taught them. Adam Alaihis Salam then told them the names. His knowledge was a gift from his Lord.

The angels acknowledged that they knew only what Allah had taught them. Adam Alaihis Salam then named what he had been taught. His knowledge was a gift from Allah, not a reason to become independent of Him.

pages.title: Iblis ka takabbur
pages.roman:
Lekin takabbur ka rawaiya bhi isi waqie mein samne aata hai. Farishton ko Adam Alaihis Salam ke samne sajde ka hukm diya gaya.

Iblis ne inkar kiya aur takabbur dikhaya. Us ne apni paidaish ka muqabla karke khud ko behtar samjha.

Iblis ne apni paidaish ko bartari ki daleel banaya aur hukm manne se inkar kiya. Yahan kahani mein pehli badi rukawat takabbur ki surat mein samne aati hai. Apne aap ko behtar samajhna use ita-at se door le gaya.
pages.english:
The angels were commanded to prostrate before Adam Alaihis Salam. Iblis refused out of arrogance and claimed superiority.

Iblis treated his origin as proof of superiority and refused the command. Pride becomes a decisive obstacle in the account: considering himself better led him away from obedience.

pages.title: Jannat aur mana kiya gaya darakht
pages.roman:
Adam Alaihis Salam aur unki biwi ko Jannat mein rehne ki ijazat mili. Wahan unhein khane ki farakhi di gayi, lekin ek darakht ke qareeb jane se mana kiya gaya.

Is ijazat ke saath ek wazeh had bhi thi. Aage ka waqia isi hukm aur Shaitan ke behkane se jurta hai. Quran darakht ki qisam nahi batata; isliye yahan uska koi naam muqarrar nahi kiya gaya.

Jannat mein rehne aur uski nematon se faida uthane ki ijazat ke saath ek saaf hadd bhi batayi gayi. Darakht ki qism ka naam in ayaat mein nahi diya gaya. Kahani ka markaz phal ki pehchan nahi, Allah Ta'ala ki hidayat ki pairwi hai.
pages.english:
Adam Alaihis Salam and his wife were permitted to live and eat freely in Paradise, with one clear restriction: they were not to approach a particular tree. The next episode concerns that command and the temptation of Satan. Permission to enjoy the Garden came with a clear boundary.

The point of the account is obedience to Allah's guidance, rather than guessing the fruit.
pages.noteEnglish: The Quran does not identify the kind of tree, so no name is added here. These verses do not identify the kind of tree.
pages.titleEnglish: The Garden and the Forbidden Tree

pages.title: Waswasa aur apni ghalati ka iqrar
pages.roman:
Shaitan ne Adam Alaihis Salam aur unki biwi ko behkaya. Unhon ne us darakht se kha liya jiske qareeb jane se mana kiya gaya tha. Phir un par apni halat zahir hui aur woh Jannat ke patton se apne aap ko dhakne lage.

Apne Rabb ke samne unhon ne apni ghalati ka iqrar kiya aur maghfirat aur rahmat mangi. Kahani yahan sirf ghalati par nahi rukti: iske saath taubah ki qubooliyat ka waqia bhi aata hai.

Shaitan ne khair-khwahi ka dawa karke unhein behkaya. Ghalati ke baad Adam Alaihis Salam aur unki zawja ne apne Rabb ke samne apna zulm tasleem kiya. Iblis ke takabbur ke muqable mein yahan taubah aur aajizi ka rasta khulta hai.
pages.english:
Satan tempted Adam Alaihis Salam and his wife, and they ate from the forbidden tree. Their nakedness became apparent to them, and they began covering themselves with leaves from Paradise.

Before their Lord they acknowledged their wrongdoing and asked for forgiveness and mercy. The account continues beyond the mistake to the acceptance of repentance.

Satan claimed to offer sincere advice. After the mistake, Adam Alaihis Salam and his wife acknowledged their wrongdoing before Allah. Unlike the pride of Iblis, their response opened the way to repentance and humility.

pages.title: Taubah aur zameen par hidayat
pages.roman:
Ghalati ke iqrar ke saath taubah ka darwaza bhi khula. Allah Ta'ala ne Adam Alaihis Salam ko taubah ke alfaaz sikhaye aur unki taubah qubool ki. Zameen par rehne ke saath Allah Ta'ala ki hidayat ki pairwi ka rasta bataya gaya.

Zameen ki zindagi sirf judai ka bayan nahi; saath hidayat ka wada bhi diya gaya. Adam Alaihis Salam ki kahani ghalati par band nahi hoti. Allah Ta'ala ki taraf lautna aur aane wali hidayat ko maanna insani zindagi ka rasta banta hai.
pages.english:
Allah accepted Adam Alaihis Salam’s repentance. Life on earth would be accompanied by guidance from Him, which people were to follow.

Life on earth was accompanied by a promise of guidance. The account does not end with the mistake. Returning to Allah and following His guidance remain central to human life.

pages.title: Do beton ki qurbani
pages.roman:
Quran Adam Alaihis Salam ke do beton ka waqia bhi sunata hai. Donon ne qurbani pesh ki; ek ki qubool hui aur doosre ki nahi. Jawab mein Allah Ta'ala ke haan taqwa ki ahmiyat batayi gayi.

Adam Alaihis Salam ke baad Quran unke do beton ka waqia sunata hai. Donon ne qurbani pesh ki, lekin qubooliyat ka taalluq taqwa se tha.
pages.english:
The Quran relates that Adam Alaihis Salam’s two sons offered sacrifices. One was accepted and the other was not. Acceptance is linked to mindfulness of Allah; the sons are not named in these verses.

The Quran next relates the account of two sons of Adam Alaihis Salam. Both offered a sacrifice, but acceptance was connected with righteousness.
pages.noteRoman: In ayaat mein beton ke naam nahi diye gaye. In ayaat mein unke naam nahi diye gaye; yahan bhi bayan ko source ki had tak rakha gaya hai.
pages.noteEnglish: The verses do not name them; this retelling does not supply names the passage omits.

pages.title: Na-haq qatl ka zulm
pages.roman:
Qurbani ke is waqie mein bhaiyon ka rawaiya mukhtalif tha. Ek bhai ne doosre ko qatl ki dhamki di.

Doosre ne Allah Ta'ala ka khauf zahir kiya. Phir uske bhai ne use qatl kar diya aur nuqsan uthane walon mein ho gaya.

Dhamki ke bawajood doosre bhai ne Allah Ta'ala ka khauf yaad dilaya. Phir bhi qatl karne wale ne apne nafs ki pairwi ki. Kahani yahan hasad se shuru hone wale zulm ko uske bhayanak anjaam tak le jati hai.
pages.english:
One brother threatened to kill the other, who expressed fear of Allah. His brother then killed him and became one of the losers.

Despite the threat, the other brother spoke of fearing Allah. The killer nevertheless followed his own impulse. The account shows how envy can lead to a terrible act of injustice.

pages.title: Zameen aur dafan ki seekh
pages.roman:
Qatl ke baad ek aur manzar samne aaya. Allah Ta'ala ne ek kawwa bheja jo zameen khod raha tha, taake qatil ko apne bhai ki mayyat chhupane ka tareeqa samajh aaye. Use apni bebasi par afsos hua.

Qatl ke baad bhi qatil apne bhai ke jism ko chhupane ka tareeqa nahi janta tha. Allah Ta'ala ne ek kawwe ke zariye use dikhaya. Jis ne doosre par quwwat dikhayi thi, woh apni kamzori par nadamat karne laga.
pages.english:
Allah sent a crow scratching the ground to show the killer how to cover his brother’s body. He recognized his helplessness and became regretful.

After the killing, the killer did not know how to conceal his brother's body. Allah showed him through a raven. The account ends with regret and a stark reminder of human helplessness.
pages.titleEnglish: Learning How to Bury the Dead

books.birthNoteEnglish: Adam Alaihis Salam’s account begins with his creation by Allah, rather than a human birth.
books.teaser: Insani kahani Adam Alaihis Salam ki takhleeq se shuru hoti hai.
books.openingRoman: Insani kahani Adam Alaihis Salam ki takhleeq se shuru hoti hai. Ilm ki nemat, Iblis ka takabbur aur taubah ki qubooliyat—yeh waqiat batate hain ke Allah Ta'ala ki hidayat insaan ki zindagi mein kitni aham hai.
books.openingEnglish: The human story begins with the creation of Adam Alaihis Salam. The gift of knowledge, the arrogance of Iblis and the acceptance of repentance introduce the need for Allah’s guidance.

books.name: Idris Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Sachche Nabi
pages.roman:
Quran Idris Alaihis Salam ko sachcha aur Nabi kehta hai. Unki paidaish, peshe ya safaron ki tafseel in ayaat mein nahi di gayi.

Unka taaruf lambi tareekhi tafseel se nahi, sachchai aur nabuwat se karaya gaya hai. Is mukhtasar zikr ko parhte hue hum unke shehar, bachpan ya rozgar ka andaaza kahani mein shamil nahi karte. Jo sifat Quran ne batayi hai, wahi is hisse ka markaz hai.
pages.english: The Quran describes Idris Alaihis Salam as a man of truth and a prophet. His introduction centres on truthfulness and prophethood rather than a long biography. This account therefore stays with the qualities the Quran actually names.
pages.noteEnglish: These verses do not narrate his birth, occupation or journeys. These passages do not supply a childhood, city or occupation.

pages.title: Buland maqam aur sabr
pages.roman:
Allah Ta'ala ne Idris Alaihis Salam ko buland maqam ata kiya. Quran unhein sabr karne walon mein shamil karta hai aur Allah Ta'ala ki rahmat mein dakhil hone ka zikr karta hai. Pehle sachchai ka taaruf hua, phir buland maqam aur sabr ka zikr milta hai.

In ayaat se Idris Alaihis Salam ki izzat aur Allah Ta'ala ki rahmat samne aati hai.
pages.english:
Allah raised Idris Alaihis Salam to a high station. He is also named among the patient and those admitted into Allah’s mercy. Truthfulness is followed by mention of a high station, patience and Allah's mercy.

These are the established features of this account.
pages.noteRoman: Unke bare mein kam tafseel milna is baat ka sabab nahi ke ghair-sabit waqiat jor diye jayen.
pages.noteEnglish: A short scriptural record is not a reason to fill the gaps with unverified events.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Idris Alaihis Salam ki zindagi ka lamba safarnama Quran mein nahi aata.
books.openingRoman: Idris Alaihis Salam ki zindagi ka lamba safarnama Quran mein nahi aata. Jo pehchan milti hai, woh bahut qeemti hai: sachchai, nabuwat, sabr aur Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se buland maqam.
books.openingEnglish: The Quran does not give a long biography of Idris Alaihis Salam. It preserves his truthfulness, prophethood, patience and the high station Allah granted him.

books.name: Nuh Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Ek qaum ko jagane ka paigham
pages.roman:
Nuh Alaihis Salam ki kahani ek saaf zimmedari se khulti hai: apni qaum ko dardnak azab aane se pehle khabardar karna. Unhon ne logon ko Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat, uske taqwa aur apni ita-at ki dawat di. Paigham ka maqsad logon ko dara kar apni zaati quwwat banana nahi tha, balki unhein Rabb ki taraf lautana tha.

Unke samne maghfirat aur mohlat ka rasta rakha gaya. Saath hi yeh bataya gaya ke jab Allah Ta'ala ki muqarrar mohlat aa jaye to use taalna insaan ke ikhtiyar mein nahi. Isi tanbeeh se unki lambi dawat ka silsila shuru hota hai.
pages.english:
The account opens with a clear responsibility: Nuh Alaihis Salam was sent to warn his people before a painful punishment. He called them to worship Allah, remain mindful of Him and obey the messenger.

The invitation offered forgiveness and respite. It also explained that Allah's appointed time could not be postponed once it came. This warning forms the opening of his long mission.
pages.titleEnglish: A Message to Awaken a People

pages.title: Apni qaum ki taraf paigham
pages.roman:
Nuh Alaihis Salam ne apni qaum ko Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat aur uske taqwa ki dawat di. Unhon ne apne paigham par dunyawi maal ka badla nahi manga.

Qaum ko apne Rabb ki taraf bulana unki zimmedari thi. Nuh Alaihis Salam ne logon ko yaad dilaya ke unka ajr Allah Ta'ala ke paas hai. Unki dawat maal jama karne ya sardari hasil karne ka zariya nahi thi. Yahi paigham unki lambi koshish ka markaz raha.
pages.english:
Nuh Alaihis Salam called his people to worship Allah and be mindful of Him. He did not ask them for wealth in return.

Calling the people to their Lord was his responsibility. Nuh Alaihis Salam made clear that his reward was with Allah. His mission was not a means to collect wealth or seek rank; this message remained central throughout his long effort.

pages.title: Sardaron ne kya dekha?
pages.roman:
Jab paigham qaum ke sardaron tak pahuncha to unhon ne uski sachchai ko imandari se parakhne ke bajaye paigham lane wale aur iman lane walon ka martaba dekha. Unhon ne Nuh Alaihis Salam ko apne jaisa bashar kaha aur unke saathiyon ko kam haisiyat samjha.

Yahan kahani ki ek aham rukawat samne aati hai: haq ko maan-ne se pehle uske manne walon ki daulat aur shohrat dekhi ja rahi thi. Nuh Alaihis Salam ne apne Rabb ki rehnumai aur rahmat ka zikr kiya. Paigham ki qeemat qaum ke in dunyawi paimanon se tay nahi hoti thi.
pages.english:
The leaders judged the messenger and his followers by social rank. They called Nuh Alaihis Salam a human like themselves and looked down on those who believed.

A major obstacle becomes visible: they were measuring truth by the wealth and standing of its followers. His response directed attention to guidance and mercy from Allah rather than worldly rank.

pages.title: Iman walon ko door nahi karunga
pages.roman:
Sardaron ke rawaiye ke jawab mein Nuh Alaihis Salam ne wazeh kiya ke woh iman lane walon ko apne paas se nahi nikalenge. Woh log apne Rabb se milne wale the; unka faisla qaum ke ghuroor ke hawale nahi kiya ja sakta tha.

Unhon ne yeh bhi nahi kaha ke unke paas Allah Ta'ala ke khazane hain, ya woh ghaib ka ilm rakhte hain, ya farishta hain. Apni hadd ko saaf rakhte hue unhon ne un logon ki qadr ki jinhein sardaar haqeer samajhte the. Kahani mein dawat ke saath insani izzat aur ikhlas ka yeh pehlu bhi samne aata hai.
pages.english:
Nuh Alaihis Salam refused to drive the believers away. They would meet their Lord; their worth was not to be decided by the leaders' contempt.

He also denied claiming Allah's treasures, knowledge of the unseen or angelic status. He kept the limits of his role clear while refusing to dismiss people whom the leaders despised.

pages.title: Din aur raat dawat
pages.roman:
Dawat sirf ek martaba ka paigham nahi thi. Nuh Alaihis Salam ne din aur raat, khule taur par aur alag se, apni qaum ko samjhaya. Unhon ne Allah Ta'ala se maghfirat mangne ki dawat di, lekin log inkar par jamay rahe.

Kabhi buland aawaz se, kabhi alag samjha kar unhon ne dawat pahunchayi. Maghfirat ki dawat ke saath barish, maal aur aulaad ki nematon ka zikr bhi aaya. Magar sunne walon mein se bahut se log kaan band karke aur zidd badha kar door hote rahe.
pages.english:
Nuh Alaihis Salam called his people by night and day, publicly and privately. He urged them to seek forgiveness, but many persisted in refusal.

He addressed them openly and privately. His invitation to seek forgiveness included mention of rain, wealth and children. Many listeners nevertheless covered their ears and persisted in rejection rather than accepting the invitation.

pages.title: Apni paidaish aur aasman ko dekho
pages.roman:
Maghfirat ki dawat ke saath Nuh Alaihis Salam ne qaum ki tawajjuh un nishaniyon ki taraf ki jo unke apne wajood aur aasman mein thin. Insaan ki marhalon mein paidaish, aasmanon ki banawat, chand ki roshni aur suraj ka zikr aata hai.

Unhein zameen aur uske khule raston ki taraf bhi mutawajjih kiya gaya. Paigham sirf ek lafz dohra dena nahi tha: logon ko apne Rabb ki qudrat par ghaur karne ki dawat thi. Phir bhi qaum ki zidd ne is samjhane ko qabool karne mein rukawat banayi rakhi.
pages.english:
Alongside the invitation to seek forgiveness, Nuh Alaihis Salam pointed to signs in human creation and the heavens. The passage mentions creation in stages, the heavens, the moon and the sun.

He also drew attention to the earth and its paths. The mission invited reflection on Allah's power rather than merely repeating a slogan. The people nevertheless persisted in refusal.
pages.titleEnglish: Signs in Creation and the Heavens

pages.title: Purani zidd ko pakre rehna
pages.roman:
Nuh Alaihis Salam ne apne Rabb ke samne qaum ke rawaiye ka zikr kiya. Log un sardaron ki pairwi karte rahe jinka maal aur aulaad unhein nuqsan se na bacha sake. Unhon ne apne maboodon ko na chhorne ki hidayat ek doosre ko di.

Quran Wadd, Suwa, Yaghuth, Yauq aur Nasr ke naam is silsile mein leta hai. Is chapter mein buton ki shaklein banane ki zarurat nahi; asal waqia us zidd ka hai jis ne dawat ko rokne ki koshish ki. Bahut se log is rawish se gumrah hue.
pages.english:
Nuh Alaihis Salam described how the people followed leaders whose wealth and children did not benefit them. They urged one another not to abandon their objects of worship. The Quran names Wadd, Suwa, Yaghuth, Yauq and Nasr in this connection.

The point is the stubborn attachment that kept people from accepting the message.
pages.noteEnglish: Their shapes need not be depicted.

pages.title: Lambi muddat
pages.roman:
Yeh koshish ek lambi muddat par phaili hui thi. Quran kehta hai ke Nuh Alaihis Salam apni qaum mein pachaas kam ek hazaar saal rahe. Yeh unki dawat ki lambi muddat ka zikr hai; ise unki poori umar ka yaqini hisab nahi banaya gaya.

Waqt guzarta raha, lekin Nuh Alaihis Salam ka paigham badla nahi. Surah Al-Ankabut unke qaum ke darmiyan nau sau pachaas saal rehne ka zikr karti hai.
pages.english: The Quran says Nuh Alaihis Salam remained among his people for a thousand years less fifty. Time passed without changing his message. Surah Al-Ankabut mentions nine hundred and fifty years among his people.
pages.noteRoman: Is muddat ko unki paidaish aur wafat ki tamam tareekhon mein badalna source se aage barhna hoga.
pages.noteEnglish: This is not presented here as a complete calculation of his lifespan. This figure does not provide a complete set of dates for his birth and death.

pages.title: Mukhalifat ke darmiyan tawakkul
pages.roman:
Qaum ki mukhalifat ke bawajood Nuh Alaihis Salam ne apne Rabb par bharose ka iqrar kiya. Agar unka logon ko Allah Ta'ala ki nishaniyan yaad dilana qaum par bhaari tha, tab bhi woh apni dawat se haath nahi khinch rahe the.

Unhon ne dobara kaha ke woh ujrat nahi mangte; unka ajr Allah Ta'ala ke zimma hai. Yeh baat pehle paigham se juri rehti hai. Mukhalifat ke saath unki dawat maal, dabao ya shohrat ki tijarat mein nahi badli. Unka sahara apne Rabb par bharosa tha.
pages.english:
Despite opposition, Nuh Alaihis Salam declared his trust in Allah. The people might find his reminders burdensome, but that did not change the source or purpose of his mission.

He again said that he asked for no payment and that his reward was with Allah. Opposition had not turned the call into a pursuit of wealth or recognition.

pages.title: Tanbeeh ko chunauti banana
pages.roman:
Qaum ne lambi guftagu ke baad Nuh Alaihis Salam se azab lane ki chunauti ki. Naseehat ko samajhne ke bajaye woh uske sach hone ka mazaq bana rahe the. Nuh Alaihis Salam ne unhein bataya ke azab lana Allah Ta'ala ke ikhtiyar mein hai.

Is jawab mein apni zaati quwwat ka dawa nahi tha. Waqia phir wahi bunyadi farq samne lata hai: Nabi paigham pahunchata hai, Allah Ta'ala ke faisle ko apni marzi se chalane wala nahi hota. Qaum ki zidd ab aur khul kar zahir ho rahi thi.
pages.english:
The people challenged Nuh Alaihis Salam to bring the punishment he warned of. He answered that only Allah would bring it if He willed.

The reply did not claim personal control over Allah's decree. A messenger conveys the warning; he does not command the outcome. The challenge made the people's persistent refusal still clearer.

pages.title: Lambi dawat ke baad ek hukm
pages.roman:
Phir Nuh Alaihis Salam ko wahi ke zariye bataya gaya ke jo iman la chuke hain unke siwa ab unki qaum mein mazeed iman nahi layega. Unhein logon ke amal par gham na karne ki hidayat di gayi. Yeh baat andaze se nahi, Allah Ta'ala ki wahi se maloom hui.

Is ke saath kashti banane ki tayyari ka rasta khula. Kahani ab logon ko bulane ke lambe silsile se us hukm ki pairwi ki taraf barhti hai jis ke saath iman walon ki nijat juri thi. Qaum ko di gayi mohlat apne anjaam ki taraf thi.
pages.english:
Revelation informed Nuh Alaihis Salam that no further people would believe beyond those who already had. He was told not to grieve over what they did. This knowledge came through revelation, not his own guess.

The command to build the ark followed. The account now moves from the long invitation towards preparation for the rescue of the believers.
pages.titleEnglish: A Command After Years of Calling

pages.title: Kashti banane ka hukm
pages.roman:
Lambi dawat ke bawajood qaum ke inkar ka silsila jari raha. Allah Ta'ala ne Nuh Alaihis Salam ko apni nigrani aur wahi ke mutabiq kashti banane ka hukm diya. Nuh Alaihis Salam kashti bana rahe the aur qaum ke sardaar guzarte hue mazaq urate the.

Isi kashti ke saath aage iman walon ki nijat ka waqia jura hai. Kashti ka kaam logon ke mazaq ke darmiyan jari raha. Zyada aham baat yeh hai ke Nuh Alaihis Salam wahi ke mutabiq tayyari kar rahe the, jabke qaum use mazaq samajh rahi thi.
pages.english:
Despite the long call, the people continued to reject the message. Allah instructed Nuh Alaihis Salam to build the ark under His care and revelation. As he built, leaders of his people passed by and mocked him.

This same ark would become part of the account of the believers’ rescue. Work on the ark continued amid mockery. They emphasise that Nuh Alaihis Salam followed revelation while his people treated the preparation with ridicule.
pages.noteRoman: Quran kashti ki lambai, manzilon ki tadaad ya tameer ki muddat yahan nahi batata.
pages.noteEnglish: These verses do not give its dimensions, number of decks or building time.
pages.titleEnglish: The Command to Build the Ark

pages.title: Apne Rabb ke samne dua
pages.roman:
Nuh Alaihis Salam ki dua mein apni, apne walidain aur iman walon ki maghfirat ka zikr aata hai. Qaum ke kufr aur gumrahi ke silsile ke bare mein bhi unhon ne Rabb se arz ki. Is dua ko unki lambi dawat aur wahi ke bayan se alag karke nahi parhna chahiye.

Yeh na kisi jaldi ka faisla tha aur na har mukhalif par baddua karne ka aam tareeqa. Quran ke is khaas waqie ki had ko barqarar rakhna zaroori hai. Ab toofan aur nijat ka marhala qareeb tha.
pages.english:
His prayer mentions forgiveness for himself, his parents and the believers. It also addresses the persistence of disbelief. This prayer belongs within the account of his long mission and the revelation concerning his people.

It is not presented as a general instruction to curse anyone who disagrees. The narrative now approaches the flood and rescue.

pages.title: Aasman aur zameen ka pani
pages.roman:
Surah Al-Qamar toofan ka manzar aasman se barasne wale pani aur zameen se phootne wale chashmon ke saath bayan karti hai. Pani ek muqarrar faisle ke mutabiq jama hua. Kashti takhton aur keelon wali sawari ke taur par yaad ki gayi.

Quran ka zor tufan ke exact naqshay, aaj ke mulkon ki hudood ya har jagah ki unchai par nahi hai. Is chapter mein bhi un andazon ko sach bana kar pesh nahi kiya gaya. Manzar Allah Ta'ala ke hukm aur uski nigrani mein nijat ki taraf mutawajjih karta hai.
pages.english: Surah Al-Qamar describes pouring water from the sky and springs from the earth meeting according to a decree. The ark is described as a vessel of planks and fastenings. Its focus remains Allah's command and rescue under His care.
pages.noteEnglish: This account does not invent a flood map or measurements for modern countries.
pages.titleEnglish: Water from the Sky and Earth

pages.title: Toofan aur sawari
pages.roman:
Phir Allah Ta'ala ka hukm aane ka waqt hua. Jab Allah Ta'ala ka hukm aaya, Nuh Alaihis Salam ko iman walon aur hukm ke mutabiq joron ko kashti mein lene ko kaha gaya. Iman lane wale kam the.

Sawari ke waqt Allah Ta'ala ke naam ko yaad kiya gaya. Kashti ki rawangi aur theharna Allah Ta'ala ke ikhtiyar mein tha. Thore se iman walon ke liye wahi kashti panah bani jis par pehle mazaq uraya gaya tha; ab waqia intezar se nijat ki taraf barh raha tha.
pages.english:
When Allah’s command came, Nuh Alaihis Salam took the believers and the commanded pairs aboard. Only a few had believed.

Allah's name was invoked as the ark set out. Its movement and resting were under His command. For the few believers it became a place of safety, in striking contrast to the earlier mockery.

pages.title: Beta aur pahad
pages.roman:
Kashti lehron ke darmiyan chal rahi thi. Nuh Alaihis Salam ne apne bete ko pukara ke woh unke saath sawar ho jaye aur inkar karne walon ke saath na rahe.

Bete ne pahad par panah lene ka khayal zahir kiya. Nuh Alaihis Salam ne bataya ke Allah Ta'ala ke faisle se uski rahmat ke siwa koi bachane wala nahi. Phir donon ke darmiyan lehar aa gayi aur beta doobne walon mein ho gaya.

Baap ki pukar aur bete ka pahad par bharosa ek hi manzar mein samne aate hain. Quran unke darmiyan aane wali lehar ka zikr karta hai. Is waqie mein qarabat ko nijat ki guarantee nahi banaya gaya; iman aur Allah Ta'ala ki rahmat hi faisla-kun hain.
pages.english:
The ark was moving among the waves. Nuh Alaihis Salam called to his son to board with them rather than remain with the disbelievers.

His son thought a mountain would shelter him. Nuh Alaihis Salam explained that no one could protect against Allah’s decree except through His mercy. A wave separated them, and the son was among those drowned.

A father's call and his son's confidence in a mountain appear within the same scene. The Quran describes the wave that separated them. Family connection alone did not guarantee rescue; Allah's mercy was decisive.

pages.title: Pani utar gaya
pages.roman:
Lehron ka silsila bhi Allah Ta'ala ke hukm ke taabe tha. Zameen ko apna pani nigalne aur aasman ko thamne ka hukm hua. Pani kam hua aur kashti Judi par thehar gayi.

Jo sawari pehle lehron ke darmiyan thi, ab apne thehrne ke maqam par thi. Dawat se kashti tak aur kashti se is thehrao tak, har marhala Allah Ta'ala ke hukm se jura raha. Is khamosh manzar ke baad Nuh Alaihis Salam ki apne Rabb se ek arz ka zikr aata hai.
pages.english:
The waves too were under Allah's command. The earth was told to absorb its water and the sky to withhold it. The waters receded and the ark rested on Judi.

The vessel that had moved among the waves was now at rest. Each stage of the account remained connected with Allah's command. The passage then turns to an address by Nuh Alaihis Salam concerning his son.

pages.title: Bete ke bare mein arz
pages.roman:
Bete ke doobne ke baad Nuh Alaihis Salam ne apne Rabb ke samne uske ahl mein se hone aur Allah Ta'ala ke wade ka zikr kiya. Jawab mein samjhaya gaya ke woh us ahl mein shamil nahi jiski nijat ka wada tha, aur uske amal ki durusti nahi thi.

Is tanbeeh par Nuh Alaihis Salam ne apni baat par zidd nahi ki. Unhon ne Allah Ta'ala se us cheez ke bare mein sawal karne se panah mangi jiska unhein ilm nahi. Apne Rabb ki maghfirat aur rahmat ki zarurat ka iqrar kiya. Yeh mor ilm ki hadd aur adab ko wazeh karta hai.
pages.english:
After his son drowned, Nuh Alaihis Salam addressed Allah concerning his family and the promise. The response explained that the son was not included in the household promised rescue.

Nuh Alaihis Salam did not persist against the correction. He sought refuge from asking about what he did not know and acknowledged his need for forgiveness and mercy.

pages.title: Salamati aur nayi shuruat
pages.roman:
Toofan, lehron aur judai ke baad utarne ka hukm salamati aur barkaton ke saath aaya. Nuh Alaihis Salam aur unke saath walon ke liye zindagi ka naya marhala tha. Quran unke bachaye jane ko nishani ke taur par yaad karta hai.

Kahani ke shuru mein qaum ko khabardar karne ki zimmedari thi; aakhir mein lambi dawat, sabr aur Rabb par bharose ka anjaam samne hai. Yeh hissa nijat ke baad ke har ghair-maloom shehar ya qaum ka naqsha nahi banata. Jo sabit hai, woh Allah Ta'ala ki rahmat aur uska sachcha wada hai.
pages.english:
The command to disembark came with peace and blessings after the flood, waves and separation. The Quran remembers the rescue as a sign. The opening duty to warn has led through patience and trust to rescue.

It preserves what is established: Allah's mercy and the truth of His promise.
pages.noteEnglish: The closing does not invent a map of later settlements.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Ek Nabi apni qaum ko baar-baar Allah Ta'ala ki taraf bulate rahe.
books.openingRoman: Ek Nabi apni qaum ko baar-baar Allah Ta'ala ki taraf bulate rahe. Nuh Alaihis Salam ki kahani lambi dawat se kashti aur toofan tak pahunchti hai—jahan nijat ka faisla quwwat ya rishtedari se nahi hua.
books.openingEnglish: Nuh Alaihis Salam repeatedly called his people to Allah. His story moves from a long mission to the ark and the flood, when strength and family ties could not secure safety.

books.name: Hud Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Aad ki taraf dawat
pages.roman:
Hud Alaihis Salam Aad ki taraf bheje gaye. Unhon ne qaum ko sirf Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat ki dawat di aur apne liye koi ujrat nahi mangi.

Hud Alaihis Salam ka paigham qaum ke liye na-ashna Rabb ki dawat nahi, usi Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat ki taraf wapsi tha jis ne unhein paida kiya. Unhon ne dawat ke badle ujrat nahi mangi. Is se pehle hi wazeh ho gaya ke muqabla maal ya sardari ka nahi tha.
pages.english:
Hud Alaihis Salam was sent to Aad. He called them to worship Allah alone and asked no payment for his message.

Hud Alaihis Salam called his people back to the worship of the One who created them. He asked for no payment. The issue was obedience to Allah, not competition for wealth or leadership.

pages.title: Quwwat par ghuroor
pages.roman:
Magar qaum ko apni quwwat par ghuroor tha. Aad ko quwwat aur imkanat mile the.

Hud Alaihis Salam ne unhein Allah Ta'ala ki nematein yaad dilayin aur takabbur se roka. Qaum ne apni taqat par ghuroor kiya.

Qaum apni jism ki quwwat ko dekh kar apne aap ko sabse taqatwar samajhne lagi. Hud Alaihis Salam ne Allah Ta'ala ki nemat yaad dilayi. Isi quwwat ne unhein aman nahi diya jab unhon ne us Rabb ki nishaniyon ka inkar kiya jis ne unhein banaya tha.
pages.english:
Aad had strength and resources. Hud Alaihis Salam reminded them of Allah’s gifts, while they arrogantly boasted of their power.

The people took pride in their strength. Hud Alaihis Salam reminded them of Allah's favours. Their power did not protect them after they rejected the signs of the One who had created them.

pages.title: Badal aur tez hawa
pages.roman:
Phir woh manzar aaya jise qaum ne barish ki umeed samjha. Unhon ne badal dekha to use barish lane wala samjha.

Woh azab wali hawa thi. Quran us tez hawa ka zikr karta hai jo un par musallat hui.

Jis badal ko dekh kar woh barish ki umeed kar rahe the, wahi unki ghalat fehmi ko kholne wala tha. Tez hawa ka azab unki quwwat par ghuroor ko mita gaya. Quran is manzar se pehle ki dawat aur uske inkar ka anjaam dikhata hai.
pages.english:
They saw a cloud and expected rain, but it brought the wind of punishment. The Quran describes a fiercely destructive wind.

They expected rain from the approaching cloud. Instead, the wind exposed their false confidence. The scene completes the earlier account of warning and rejection: strength could not keep Allah's decree away.

pages.title: Iman walon ki nijat
pages.roman:
Is anjaam mein iman walon ki nijat ka zikr bhi hai. Allah Ta'ala ne Hud Alaihis Salam aur unke saath iman lane walon ko apni rahmat se bacha liya. Qaum ki quwwat Allah Ta'ala ke faisle ko rok na saki.

Azab ke bayan ke saath Quran nijat ko bhi alag se yaad karta hai. Hud Alaihis Salam aur unke saath iman lane wale Allah Ta'ala ki rahmat se bachaye gaye. Is kahani mein fasla taqatwar aur kamzor ka nahi, inkar aur iman ka hai.
pages.english:
Allah saved Hud Alaihis Salam and the believers with him through His mercy. Their people’s worldly strength could not prevent His judgment.

Alongside the punishment, the Quran specifically records rescue. Hud Alaihis Salam and the believers with him were saved through Allah's mercy. The decisive distinction was belief and rejection, rather than physical strength.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Aad ko apni taqat par naaz tha.
books.openingRoman: Aad ko apni taqat par naaz tha. Hud Alaihis Salam ne unhein unke Rabb ki yaad dilayi. Is kahani mein quwwat ke ghuroor aur Allah Ta'ala par iman ka anjaam samne aata hai.
books.openingEnglish: The people of Aad were proud of their strength. Hud Alaihis Salam reminded them of their Lord. Their story contrasts pride in power with faith in Allah.

books.name: Salih Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Thamud aur pahari ghar
pages.roman:
Salih Alaihis Salam ne Thamud ko Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat ki dawat di. Unki qaum paharon mein ghar tarashti thi. Quran is hunar ke saath unki zimmedari bhi yaad dilata hai.

Paharon ko tarash kar banaye gaye ghar qaum ki maharat ki nishani the. Salih Alaihis Salam ne unhein Allah Ta'ala ki nematein yaad dilayi aur zameen mein fasad se roka. Achhi tameer apne aap mein ita-at ka badal nahi thi.
pages.english:
Salih Alaihis Salam called Thamud to worship Allah. His people carved homes into mountains, but their skill did not remove their responsibility to Him.

Their homes carved into mountains displayed great skill. Salih Alaihis Salam reminded them of Allah's favours and warned against corruption. Impressive buildings could not take the place of obedience.

pages.title: Allah ki nishani
pages.roman:
Isi qaum ke samne Allah Ta'ala ki ek nishani pesh hui. Qaum ke liye oontni ek nishani thi. Salih Alaihis Salam ne usko nuqsan na pahunchane ko kaha.

Pani ke liye uska aur qaum ka muqarrar hissa tha. Pani ki bari ke bare mein saaf hidayat di gayi thi. Agla waqia batata hai ke qaum ne is hadd ke saath kya kiya.
pages.english:
A she-camel was a sign for the people. Salih Alaihis Salam warned them not to harm her, and water was to be shared on appointed turns. Clear instructions governed the sharing of water.

Its focus is respect for Allah's command; what follows shows how the people responded to that boundary.
pages.noteRoman: Nishani ka zikr kisi jandar ki tasveer banane ke baghair bhi samjha ja sakta hai: asal maqsad Allah Ta'ala ki muqarrar hadd ka ehtram tha.
pages.noteEnglish: The story can be told without depicting a living creature.

pages.title: Hukm ki khilaf warzi
pages.roman:
Lekin qaum ne is tanbeeh ka lihaz na kiya. Qaum ne oontni ko maar diya aur apne Rabb ke hukm se sarkashi ki. Salih Alaihis Salam ne unhein teen din ki mohlat ki khabar di.

Jab unhon ne nishani ko nuqsan pahunchaya to tanbeeh ko khuli nafarmani mein badal diya. Unhein apne gharon mein teen din faida utha lene ki mohlat batayi gayi. Is ke baad anjaam sirf ek door ki dhamki nahi raha.
pages.english:
The people killed the she-camel and defied their Lord’s command. Salih Alaihis Salam announced a respite of three days. No animal is illustrated.

By harming the sign, they turned rejection into open disobedience. They were told of three days' respite in their homes. The promised consequence was now close, rather than a distant warning.
pages.noteRoman: Is waqia ki jaanwar wali tasveer nahi banayi gayi.

pages.title: Nijat aur anjaam
pages.roman:
Phir Allah Ta'ala ke faisle ka waqt aaya. Allah Ta'ala ne Salih Alaihis Salam aur iman walon ko bachaya. Zulm karne walon ko saikha ne aa liya aur unke ghar unhein na bacha sake.

Wohi ghar jo unki maharat aur aman ki alamat lagte the, unhein bacha na sake. Salih Alaihis Salam aur iman walon ki nijat Allah Ta'ala ki rahmat se hui. Kahani ke shuru ke mazboot ghar aur aakhri anjaam ko saath parhna uski tanbeeh wazeh karta hai.
pages.english:
Allah saved Salih Alaihis Salam and the believers. Those who did wrong were overtaken by the blast; their homes could not protect them.

The houses that appeared to offer security did not save their occupants. Salih Alaihis Salam and the believers were rescued by Allah's mercy. The contrast with those impressive homes brings the warning into focus.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Paharon mein tarashe hue ghar Thamud ke hunar ki nishani the.
books.openingRoman: Paharon mein tarashe hue ghar Thamud ke hunar ki nishani the. Salih Alaihis Salam ne unhein Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat ki taraf bulaya; phir oontni ki nishani unke liye ita-at ki azmaish bani.
books.openingEnglish: The rock-carved homes of Thamud displayed their skill. Salih Alaihis Salam called them to worship Allah, and the she-camel became a sign and a test of obedience.

books.name: Ibrahim Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Rushd aur haq ki taraf rujoo
pages.roman:
Jab log apne aqeede par chale aa rahe the, Ibrahim Alaihis Salam haq ki taraf mutawajjah the. Allah Ta'ala ne unhein rushd ata kiya tha. Unki kahani ka markaz yahi pehchan hai: ibadat sirf us Rabb ki jo sab ka paida karne wala hai.

Quran Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ke is rujoo ko Allah Ta'ala ki di hui rushd se jorta hai. Unki qaum ke buton ko bas riwayat ki wajah se qabool kar lena kahani ka rasta nahi banta. Agle hisse mein yahi haq ki talaash apne walid se guftagu mein nazar aati hai.
pages.english:
Allah granted Ibrahim Alaihis Salam sound judgment. This account begins with his scripturally established call, without adding an unreported birth date or childhood legend.

The Quran connects his sound judgement with Allah's guidance. The inherited practice of idol worship is not accepted merely because it is familiar. This commitment to truth next appears in his conversation with his father.
pages.titleEnglish: Guidance and the Search for Truth

pages.title: Walid ko narmi se samjhana
pages.roman:
Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ki dawat apne walid tak bhi pahunchi. Unhon ne adab aur narmi se aisi cheezon ki ibadat par sawal kiya jo na sun sakti thin, na dekh sakti thin aur na madad kar sakti thin.

Woh apne walid ko hidayat ki taraf bula rahe the. Haq ki baat kehne ke saath unke andaaz mein narmi bhi thi.

Unhon ne baar-baar adab ke saath apne walid ko mukhatib kiya. Sakht jawab milne par bhi unka lehja be-adbi ka nahi bana. Yeh guftagu unki dawat ka ek pehlu kholti hai: haq wazeh kehna aur samne wale se narmi rakhna saath chal sakte hain.
pages.english:
Ibrahim Alaihis Salam respectfully questioned his father about worshipping what could neither hear nor see, and invited him to guidance.

He addressed his father respectfully, even when the response was harsh. The exchange shows that stating the truth clearly need not mean abandoning gentleness towards the person being addressed.

pages.title: Sitara, chand aur suraj
pages.roman:
Qaumi aqeede par sawal sirf buton tak mehdood nahi tha. Sitara, chand aur suraj—sab dhal jate hain.

Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ne isi baat ko apni qaum ke samne daleel banaya. Unhon ne apna rukh us zaat ki taraf kiya jis ne aasman aur zameen ko paida kiya. Dhal jane wali cheezein unka Rabb nahi thin.

Doobne wale sitare, chand aur suraj ka zikr unhein paida karne wale Rabb ki taraf mutawajjih karta hai. Ibadat ka markaz badalne wali cheez nahi ho sakti. Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ne apna rukh aasmanon aur zameen ke paida karne wale ki taraf kiya.
pages.english:
Ibrahim Alaihis Salam’s argument drew attention to the setting star, moon and sun. He turned toward the Creator of the heavens and earth.

The setting star, moon and sun direct attention beyond created things. Ibrahim Alaihis Salam turned towards the Creator of the heavens and earth. The account distinguishes the changing creation from the One worthy of worship.
pages.titleEnglish: The Star, the Moon and the Sun

pages.title: Buton ke bare mein sawal
pages.roman:
Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ne qaum ke buton ke bare mein bhi sawal uthaye. Phir unhon ne unhein tor diya aur bade but ko chhor diya.

Logon ko apne hi aqeede par ghaur karne ka mauqa mila: jinhein woh pukarte hain, kya woh apna bhi bachao kar sakte hain? Yeh waqia qaum ko sochne ki taraf bulata hai.

Qaum se sawalon ne unke buton ki be-basi ko samne la diya. Unhon ne apne andar ghalati mehsoos ki, lekin phir apni zidd ki taraf palat gaye. Daleel ke is muqable ke baad kahani unke sakht faisle ki taraf barhti hai.
pages.english:
Ibrahim Alaihis Salam challenged his people’s idols and broke them except the largest, prompting them to confront their beliefs.

The questions exposed the idols' helplessness. The people briefly recognised their own error, then returned to stubbornness. The failure to follow the evidence led to a far harsher response.

pages.title: Aag se hifazat
pages.roman:
Qaumi jawab daleel ko qabool karna nahi tha. Unhon ne Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ko jalane ka irada kiya.

Lekin aag bhi Allah Ta'ala ke hukm ke taabe thi: Allah Ta'ala ne use Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ke liye thandi aur salamati wali hone ka hukm diya. Unke khilaf ki gayi tadbeer nakaam hui aur Allah Ta'ala ne unki hifazat ki.

Qaum ne nuksan pahunchane ka irada kiya tha, magar Allah Ta'ala ne unki tadbeer ko nakaam kiya. Aag ke liye thandak aur salamati ka hukm aaya. Is manzar mein nijat ka sabab na qaum ki razamandi thi aur na dunyawi quwwat, balki Allah Ta'ala ki hifazat thi.
pages.english:
His people intended to burn Ibrahim Alaihis Salam. Allah commanded the fire to be cool and safe for him, and their plot failed.

The people intended harm, but Allah defeated their plan. The fire was commanded to be cool and safe. Rescue came through Allah's protection, not through the approval or power of the people.

pages.title: Rabb ke bare mein daleel
pages.roman:
Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ki zindagi ka ek aur waqia ek hukmaran ke samne haq bayan karne ka hai. Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ne apne Rabb ko zindagi aur maut dene wala bataya. Phir unhon ne suraj ke mashriq se nikalne ki daleel rakhi.

Inkar karne wala is daleel ka jawab na de saka. Hukumat ka dawa karne wale ke samne Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ne Rabb ki qudrat ki daleel di. Suraj ko mashriq se lane wale Allah Ta'ala ke muqable mein use maghrib se lane ka sawal hua.
pages.english:
Ibrahim Alaihis Salam argued with a ruler about the Lord who gives life and death, then challenged him concerning the rising sun. The disbeliever was confounded. Ibrahim Alaihis Salam presented evidence of Allah's power before a ruler.

The challenge concerned bringing the sun from the opposite direction.
pages.noteRoman: Quran hukmaran ka naam yahan nahi batata.
pages.noteEnglish: The Quran does not name that ruler in this passage.

pages.title: Dil ka itminan
pages.roman:
Apne Rabb par iman ke saath Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ne dil ke mazeed itminan ki darkhwast bhi ki. Unhon ne Allah Ta'ala se murdon ko zinda karne ki kaifiyat ke bare mein poocha.

Unka sawal iman ke inkar ka nahi tha; woh dil ka itminan chahte the. Allah Ta'ala ne unhein apni qudrat ki nishani dikhayi.

Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ne apne iman ka iqrar kiya aur dil ke mazeed itminan ki darkhwast ki. Unhein jis tarah amal karne ko kaha gaya, uski pairwi ki. Yeh sawal inkar ka nahi, apne Rabb ki qudrat par dil ke sukoon ka tha.
pages.english:
Ibrahim Alaihis Salam asked to see how Allah gives life to the dead. He affirmed his belief and sought reassurance of the heart; Allah showed him a sign.

He affirmed his belief and asked for reassurance of heart. He followed the instructions Allah gave him. The passage presents a request for reassurance, not a rejection of Allah's power.

pages.title: Hijrat aur nek aulaad ki dua
pages.roman:
Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ki kahani mein dua ka silsila bhi chalta hai. Unhon ne apne Rabb ki taraf jane ka irada zahir kiya aur nek aulaad mangi.

Allah Ta'ala ne unhein ek burdbar bete ki khushkhabri di. Yeh nemat unki zindagi mein ita-at ki ek badi azmaish ke zikr ke saath aati hai.

Qaum se alag hone ke baad unki tawajjuh apne Rabb ki rehnumai par rahi. Nek aulaad ki dua ke jawab mein hilm wale bete ki basharat mili. Ab dawat ki kahani ke saath gharane ki azmaish aur ibadat ke waqiat bhi jurte hain.
pages.english:
Ibrahim Alaihis Salam declared that he was going to his Lord and prayed for a righteous child. He received glad tidings of a forbearing son.

After leaving his people, he continued to rely on Allah's guidance. The prayer for righteous offspring was followed by good news of a forbearing son. The account now turns towards the trials and worship of his household.
pages.titleEnglish: Migration and a Prayer for Children

pages.title: Hajar aur Ismail Alaihis Salam ki waadi
pages.roman:
Ibrahim Alaihis Salam Hajar aur doodh peete Ismail Alaihis Salam ko Makkah ki waadi mein laye. Us waqt wahan na abadi thi aur na pani. Unke paas khajoor aur pani ki ek mashk chhor di gayi.

Jab Hajar ko maloom hua ke yeh Allah Ta'ala ka hukm hai, unhon ne Allah Ta'ala par bharosa kiya. Is be-aab waadi mein unke aur unke bachche ke saamne ab pani ki zaroorat thi—aur isi se Safa aur Marwa ki talaash ka waqia jurta hai.

Hajar ne poochha ke kya yeh Allah Ta'ala ka hukm hai. Jab unhein is ka yaqeen hua to unhon ne Allah Ta'ala par bharosa kiya. Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ne wahan apni aulaad ke liye namaz, rizq aur logon ke dilon ki muhabbat ki dua ki.
pages.english:
Ibrahim Alaihis Salam brought Hajar and the nursing Ismail Alaihis Salam to the valley of Makkah. No one lived there, and there was no water. Dates and a small waterskin were left with them.

When Hajar learned that this was Allah’s command, she trusted Him. The need for water in that valley leads into her search between Safa and Marwa.

Hajar asked whether this was Allah's command. Once assured, she placed her trust in Him. Ibrahim Alaihis Salam prayed for worship, provision and the affection of people towards his family in the valley.
pages.titleEnglish: Hajar and Ismail Alaihis Salam in the Valley

pages.title: Safa se talaash
pages.roman:
Mashk ka pani khatam hua to Hajar pani aur madad ki talaash mein niklin. Qareeb ke paharon mein Safa par charhkar unhon ne waadi ki taraf dekha ke shayad koi nazar aaye.

Wahan koi nazar nahi aaya. Talaash ka yeh pehla marhala tha; Hajar ne ab waadi ke doosre kinare, Marwa ki taraf rukh kiya.

Pani khatam hone par Hajar ne baith kar sirf intezar nahi kiya. Woh Safa par chadh kar kisi insaan ko dekhne ki koshish kartin. Ujri hui waadi aur bachche ki zarurat ke darmiyan unki talaash agle manzar ko janam deti hai.
pages.english:
When the waterskin was empty, Hajar went to look for help. She climbed Safa, the nearest hill, and searched the valley for anyone she could see.

No one was visible. Her search did not end there: she descended towards the valley and continued towards Marwa.

When the water ran out, Hajar did not simply wait. She climbed Safa, looking for someone who could help. Her search connects the need of her child with the next part of the account.

pages.title: Safa aur Marwa ke darmiyan
pages.roman:
Safa se utarkar Hajar waadi se guzrin aur Marwa par charhin. Wahan se bhi unhon ne dekha, lekin koi nazar na aaya. Madad ki talaash mein Safa aur Marwa ke darmiyan unka aana-jana saat martaba hua.

Is koshish ke baad waqia us jagah ki taraf aata hai jahan Allah Ta'ala ne pani ata kiya. Waadi ke neeche ke hisse mein woh tezi se guzartin aur phir doosre pahaar par nazar dalti thin. Unhon ne Safa aur Marwa ke darmiyan saat chakkar kiye.
pages.english:
Hajar descended from Safa, crossed the valley and climbed Marwa. From there too, she looked for someone, but saw no one.

She made the journey between Safa and Marwa seven times. The account then turns to the place where Allah provided water.

She crossed the lower part of the valley quickly and looked out from the other hill. The report describes seven journeys between Safa and Marwa. The scene can be illustrated through the valley and hills alone.
pages.noteRoman: Riwayat is koshish ko yaad rakhti hai; tasveer mein sirf pahaar aur waadi dikhayi jayegi.

pages.title: Zamzam ka pani
pages.roman:
Hajar ne Zamzam ki jagah farishte ko zameen khodte dekha. Sahih riwayat mein farishte ki erhi ya par ka zikr aata hai. Wahan pani zahir hua.

Hajar ne pani ko jama karna shuru kiya aur apni mashk bhari. Jis waadi mein pani na tha, usi mein ab Zamzam mil gaya tha. Aage isi pani ke qareeb logon ki abadi ka zikr aata hai.

Riwayat mein farishte ke zariye zameen se pani nikalne ka zikr hai. Hajar ne pani ko sametne ki koshish ki aur apne mashkize mein bhara. Nijat ko bachche ke pairon ki apni quwwat se mansoob karna is riwayat ka bayan nahi.
pages.english:
Hajar saw an angel at the place of Zamzam, digging with his heel or wing, as the authentic narration describes. Water began to flow there.

She gathered it and filled her waterskin. The valley that had held no water now had Zamzam. The next part of the account describes people settling beside it.

The report describes water appearing through the angel's action. Hajar gathered it and filled her water container. This account does not attribute the spring to the child's own power or movement.

pages.title: Waadi mein abadkari
pages.roman:
Zamzam ke pani ke sabab waadi mein rehne ka imkan paida hua. Jurhum ke log wahan aaye aur Hajar ki ijazat se qareeb rehne lage.

Ismail Alaihis Salam unke darmiyan barhe aur unse Arabi seekhi. Be-aab waadi, jahan ek maa aur bachcha the, ab logon ki abadi ka maqam ban gayi thi.

Pani ki maujoodgi ne waadi ki surat badal di. Jurhum ke logon ne wahan rehne ki ijazat mangi aur Hajar ne pani par apna haq barqarar rakhte hue ijazat di. Ismail Alaihis Salam isi abadi ke darmiyan barhe hue.
pages.english:
The water of Zamzam made settlement possible in the valley. People of Jurhum arrived and, with Hajar’s permission, settled nearby.

Ismail Alaihis Salam grew up among them and learned Arabic from them. The once uninhabited valley had become a place where families lived.

The presence of water changed the valley. People of Jurhum requested permission to settle, and Hajar allowed them while retaining her right to the water. Ismail Alaihis Salam grew up among this community.

pages.title: Khwaab aur ita-at ki azmaish
pages.roman:
Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ki ita-at ki ek badi azmaish Quran qurbani ke waqie mein bayan karta hai. Unhon ne apne bete ko khwaab mein qurbani dekhne ki baat batayi. Donon ne Allah Ta'ala ki ita-at ikhtiyar ki.

Allah Ta'ala ne is azmaish ke anjaam par badi qurbani ka fidya diya. Baap ne khwaab ka zikr bete ke samne rakha aur bete ne sabr aur ita-at ka jawab diya. Allah Ta'ala ne is azmaish ka anjaam fidye ki surat mein farmaya.
pages.english:
Ibrahim Alaihis Salam told his son of the sacrificial dream. Both submitted to Allah, and Allah provided a great sacrifice in ransom. The father explained the dream and the son responded with patience and obedience.

Allah brought the trial to its conclusion through a ransom.
pages.noteRoman: In ayaat mein bete ka naam nahi diya gaya. In ayaat mein bete ka naam nahi aata; is liye yahan naam ka ikhtilaf faisla karke pesh nahi kiya gaya.
pages.noteEnglish: These verses do not name the son. These verses do not name the son, so this retelling does not settle the identification by assertion.
pages.titleEnglish: A Dream and a Test of Obedience

pages.title: Ishaq Alaihis Salam ki khushkhabri
pages.roman:
Quran Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ke ghar ek aur khushkhabri ka zikr bhi karta hai. Farishton ne Ishaq Alaihis Salam aur uske baad Yaqub Alaihis Salam ki basharat di.

Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ki biwi ne apni aur shohar ki bari umar dekhkar hairat ki. Lekin jis Rabb ka yeh faisla tha, uske liye yeh mushkil nahi tha.

Mehmanon ke khane ki taraf haath na barhne par khauf hua, phir unhon ne apna paigham wazeh kiya. Barhape ke bawajood Ishaq Alaihis Salam aur unke baad Yaqub Alaihis Salam ki basharat mili. Allah Ta'ala ki rahmat insani andaazon ki paband nahi.
pages.english:
Angelic messengers announced Ishaq Alaihis Salam and, after him, Yaqub Alaihis Salam. Ibrahim Alaihis Salam’s wife was astonished in old age, but this was Allah’s decree.

The guests' refusal to eat caused concern before they explained their message. Good news of Ishaq Alaihis Salam and then Yaqub Alaihis Salam came despite old age. The passage points to Allah's mercy beyond ordinary human expectations.
pages.titleEnglish: The Good News of Ishaq Alaihis Salam

pages.title: Kaaba ki bunyadein
pages.roman:
Makkah ki isi waadi se Allah Ta'ala ke ghar ki tameer ka azeem waqia bhi jura hai. Ibrahim Alaihis Salam aur Ismail Alaihis Salam milkar Kaaba ki bunyadein utha rahe the.

Unki mehnat ke saath dua bhi thi: apne Rabb se is amal ki qubooliyat mang rahe the. Unhon ne apne liye aur apni aulaad mein ek ummat ke liye Allah Ta'ala ki farmanbardari ki dua ki.

Bunyadein uthate waqt baap aur beta apne amal ki qubooliyat mang rahe the. Unki dua mein aane wali nasal aur ek Rasool ki basharat ki darkhwast bhi shamil thi. Tameer ka yeh manzar sirf imarat ka nahi, bandagi aur aajizi ka hai.
pages.english:
Another great event linked to this valley is the building of Allah’s House. Ibrahim Alaihis Salam and Ismail Alaihis Salam raised the foundations of the Kaaba together.

Their work was accompanied by supplication: they asked their Lord to accept it. They also prayed for submission to Allah for themselves and for a community among their descendants.

While raising the foundations, father and son prayed for acceptance. Their prayer also concerned future descendants and a messenger among them. Building the House was joined with humility and worship.
pages.titleEnglish: Raising the Foundations of the Kaaba

pages.title: Aman aur ibadat ki dua
pages.roman:
Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ki dua mein shehar ka aman bhi tha aur apni aulaad ka deen bhi. Unhon ne but-parasti se hifazat, namaz qayam rakhne aur maghfirat ki darkhwast ki.

Unki kahani mein tawheed, ita-at aur dua baar-baar samne aate hain. Nematon ke darmiyan bhi unka rujoo apne Rabb hi ki taraf tha.

Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ki duaein unki zaati zarurat par khatam nahi hotin. Woh apni aulaad ko but-parasti se bachane, namaz qayam rakhne aur maghfirat ki dua karte hain. Kahani ka yeh ikhtitam unki dawat aur gharane ko ek hi maqsad mein jorta hai.
pages.english:
Ibrahim Alaihis Salam prayed for the city’s safety, protection from idol worship, steadfast prayer and forgiveness. His story centres on worship and submission to Allah.

His prayers reached beyond personal needs. They concerned protection from idolatry, establishing prayer and forgiveness. This conclusion brings his mission and household together around the worship of Allah.
pages.titleEnglish: A Prayer for Peace and Worship

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ki kahani tawheed ki dawat, hijrat, dua aur ita-at ke waqiat ko jorti hai.
books.openingRoman: Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ki kahani tawheed ki dawat, hijrat, dua aur ita-at ke waqiat ko jorti hai. Qaum ke buton se Makkah ki be-aab waadi aur Kaaba ki bunyadon tak, unka rujoo apne Rabb hi ki taraf raha.
books.openingEnglish: The story of Ibrahim Alaihis Salam brings together the call to worship Allah alone, migration, prayer and obedience. Its scenes extend from his people’s idols to the valley of Makkah and the foundations of the Kaaba.

books.name: Lut Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Qaum ko naseehat
pages.roman:
Lut Alaihis Salam ne apni qaum ko behayai aur zulm se roka. Unhon ne unki aisi bad-amali ki nishandahi ki jo Quran ne wazeh taur par bayan ki hai.

Qaum ki ghalat rawish ko sirf aadat keh kar chhor dena unka paigham nahi tha. Lut Alaihis Salam ne unhein Allah Ta'ala ke samne jawabdehi yaad dilayi. In ayaat mein badkari ke saath raste ki zyadati aur majlison ki burai ka zikr bhi aata hai.
pages.english:
Lut Alaihis Salam warned his people against grave indecency and wrongdoing. The Quran describes his condemnation of their conduct.

Lut Alaihis Salam did not treat the wrongdoing as harmless custom. He reminded his people of accountability. The cited passages also mention abuse on the road and wrongdoing in their gatherings.

pages.title: Mehmanon ki amad
pages.roman:
Qaumi rawaiye ka ek aur manzar mehmanon ki amad par samne aaya. Farishtay Lut Alaihis Salam ke paas mehmanon ki surat mein aaye.

Lut Alaihis Salam ko apni qaum ke rawaiye ka khauf hua. Farishton ne bataya ke woh Allah Ta'ala ke bheje hue hain.

Mehmanon ki amad par Lut Alaihis Salam ko qaum ke rawaiye ki wajah se tashweesh hui. Unhon ne mehmanon ki hifazat chahi, jabke qaum apni zidd par thi. Isi mushkil lamhe mein mehmanon ne wazeh kiya ke woh Rabb ke bheje hue farishte hain.
pages.english:
Angelic messengers came to Lut Alaihis Salam as guests. Distressed by his people’s behaviour, he was reassured that the visitors were messengers from Allah.

The arrival of guests troubled Lut Alaihis Salam because of his people's behaviour. As he sought to protect them, the guests revealed that they were messengers from his Lord.

pages.title: Raat ko nikalne ka hukm
pages.roman:
Farishton ke paigham mein nikalne ki hidayat bhi thi. Lut Alaihis Salam ko apne ghar walon ko raat ke ek hisse mein le jane ka hukm mila. Unki biwi bachne walon mein shamil nahi thi.

Ab hidayat sirf naseehat ki nahi, waqt par rawangi ki thi. Ghar walon ko raat ke ek hisse mein le jane ka hukm hua. Is safar ka maqsad azab se pehle nijat tha; apne logon ki mukhalifat ke bawajood Allah Ta'ala ki hidayat mani gayi.
pages.english:
Lut Alaihis Salam was instructed to leave with his household during the night. His wife was not among those who would be saved.

The instruction now concerned departure before the punishment. He was told to leave with his household during the night. The response required obedience despite the opposition surrounding him.
pages.titleEnglish: The Command to Leave at Night

pages.title: Nijat aur basti ka anjaam
pages.roman:
Yeh rawangi nijat ka sabab bani. Allah Ta'ala ne Lut Alaihis Salam aur unke iman wale ghar walon ko bachaya.

Basti par azab aaya. Quran is waqia ko baad mein guzarne walon ke liye nishani batata hai.

Nijat ke bayan mein unki zawja ko bachne walon mein shamil nahi kiya gaya. Qarabat apne aap mein hifazat ka wada nahi thi. Qaum ka anjaam aur iman walon ki nijat, dono is waqie ke pehle paigham ko wazeh karte hain.
pages.english:
Allah saved Lut Alaihis Salam and his believing household. Punishment overtook the town, leaving a sign for those who would pass by.

His wife was not included among those rescued. Family relationship alone was not a promise of safety. The destruction and rescue both complete the warning with which the account began.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Lut Alaihis Salam ne apni qaum ko bad-amali se roka.
books.openingRoman: Lut Alaihis Salam ne apni qaum ko bad-amali se roka. Mehmanon ki amad aur raat ki rawangi ke waqiat ke saath yeh kahani Allah Ta'ala ki hifazat aur zulm ke anjaam ko bayan karti hai.
books.openingEnglish: Lut Alaihis Salam warned his people against wrongdoing. The arrival of visitors and the departure by night lead into an account of Allah’s protection and the consequences of oppression.

books.name: Ismail Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ki dua aur bete ki nemat ka zikr Quran mein hai. Ismail Alaihis Salam ki shuruati zindagi Makkah mein Sahih Bukhari ki riwayat se bayan hoti hai.

pages.title: Dua aur aulaad ki nemat
pages.roman:
Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ne nek aulaad ki dua ki. Quran mein unhon ne barhape mein Ismail Alaihis Salam aur Ishaq Alaihis Salam milne par Allah Ta'ala ka shukr ada kiya.

Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ki dua aur shukr ke zikr mein aulaad ko Allah Ta'ala ki ata kaha gaya hai. Ismail Alaihis Salam ki kahani isi nemat ke saath shuru hoti hai. Aage is gharane ko waadi, pani ki zarurat aur ibadat ki azmaishon se guzarte dekhte hain.
pages.english:
Ibrahim Alaihis Salam prayed for righteous offspring and thanked Allah for granting Ismail Alaihis Salam and Ishaq Alaihis Salam in old age.

In Ibrahim Alaihis Salam's prayer and gratitude, children are recognised as Allah's gift. This account begins with that blessing, then turns to the valley, the need for water and the family's worship.
pages.titleEnglish: A Prayer and the Gift of a Child

pages.title: Makkah mein bachpan
pages.roman:
Ismail Alaihis Salam ke bachpan ka ek aham waqia Makkah ki waadi se jura hai. Ismail Alaihis Salam doodh peete bachche the jab Ibrahim Alaihis Salam unhein unki walida ke saath Makkah laye. Us waqt wahan na abadi thi aur na pani.

Wahan na abadi thi aur na pani ka aasaan zariya. Hajar ka bharosa Allah Ta'ala par tha, lekin bachche ki dekhbhal aur pani ki talaash bhi jari rahi. Bachpan ka yeh waqia baad ki Makkah ki abadi se seedha jura hua hai.
pages.english:
Ismail Alaihis Salam was a nursing infant when Ibrahim Alaihis Salam brought him and his mother to Makkah, then an uninhabited place without water.

There was no settled community or ready water supply. Hajar trusted Allah while caring for her child and seeking water. This childhood account is directly connected with the later settlement of Makkah.

pages.title: Hajar ki talaash aur Zamzam
pages.roman:
Isi be-aab waadi mein pani ki zaroorat pesh aayi. Pani khatam hua to Ismail Alaihis Salam ki walida Safa aur Marwa ke darmiyan madad ki talaash mein gayin. Allah Ta'ala ne Zamzam ka pani ata kiya.

Safa aur Marwa ke darmiyan unki walida ki koshish ke baad pani ka zariya mila. Hajar ne pani sameta aur Ismail Alaihis Salam ki zarurat poori hui. Nijat ka yeh manzar baad mein dusre logon ke wahan rehne ka sabab bhi bana.
pages.english:
When their water ran out, Ismail Alaihis Salam’s mother searched between Safa and Marwa. Allah provided water at Zamzam.

After his mother's search between Safa and Marwa, water became available. Hajar gathered it and cared for Ismail Alaihis Salam. The same spring became part of the reason others settled in the valley.

pages.title: Abadi aur jawani
pages.roman:
Zamzam ke baad waadi mein abadi ka silsila hua. Jurhum ke log pani ke qareeb abad hue.

Ismail Alaihis Salam unke darmiyan barhe, Arabi seekhi aur bade hokar unmein shadi ki. Riwayat inki zindagi ka yeh hissa bayan karti hai.

Jurhum ke logon ke darmiyan unhon ne Arabi seekhi. Riwayat unki parwarish aur phir jawani ka zikr karti hai. Is tarah pehle tanha gharane ki kahani ek abadi se jurti hai, jahan baad mein Ibrahim Alaihis Salam dobara aaye.
pages.english:
People of Jurhum settled near the water. Ismail Alaihis Salam grew up among them, learned Arabic and later married into their community.

He learned Arabic among the people of Jurhum. The report follows his growth into adulthood. The once isolated household became part of a settlement to which Ibrahim Alaihis Salam later returned.

pages.title: Walid ke saath ghar ki tameer
pages.roman:
Ismail Alaihis Salam ki kahani aage ek azeem ibadat ke ghar se jurti hai. Ismail Alaihis Salam ne Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ke saath Allah Ta'ala ke ghar ki bunyadein uthayin. Donon apne Rabb se qubooliyat aur farmanbardari ki dua karte rahe.

Dono ne sirf tameer ka kaam nahi kiya; saath Allah Ta'ala se qubooliyat bhi mangi. Aane wali nasal ke liye bandagi aur rehnumai ki dua ki gayi. Ismail Alaihis Salam ki kahani mein bachpan ka tawakkul ab apne amal aur zimmedari ke saath nazar aata hai.
pages.english:
Ismail Alaihis Salam helped Ibrahim Alaihis Salam raise the foundations of the House. Together they prayed for acceptance and submission to Allah.

Their work was accompanied by prayer for acceptance and guidance for future generations. The account moves from the trust surrounding his childhood to his own worship and responsibility.
pages.titleEnglish: Building the House with His Father

pages.title: Sachcha wada aur namaz
pages.roman:
Quran unki shakhsiyat ki pehchan bhi karata hai. Quran Ismail Alaihis Salam ko wade ka sachcha, rasool aur Nabi kehta hai. Woh apne ghar walon ko namaz aur zakat ka hukm dete the aur apne Rabb ke nazdeek pasandeeda the.

Quran unki sachchai ko gharane ki rehnumai ke saath rakhta hai. Woh apne ahl ko namaz aur zakat ka hukm dete the aur apne Rabb ke nazdeek pasandeeda the. Yahi sifat is kahani ko sirf ek tareekhi waqie se barh kar amal ki yaad banati hai.
pages.english:
The Quran calls Ismail Alaihis Salam true to his promise, a messenger and prophet. He instructed his family in prayer and charity and was pleasing to his Lord.

The Quran joins his truthfulness with guidance of his household. He instructed them in prayer and charity and was pleasing to his Lord. These qualities bring the account towards worship in everyday life.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran recalls Ibrahim Alaihis Salam’s prayer and the gift of children. Sahih Bukhari relates Ismail Alaihis Salam’s infancy in Makkah.
books.teaser: Ismail Alaihis Salam ki shuruati zindagi Makkah ki be-aab waadi se jurti hai.
books.openingRoman: Ismail Alaihis Salam ki shuruati zindagi Makkah ki be-aab waadi se jurti hai. Zamzam ke pani, waadi ki abadi aur apne walid ke saath Kaaba ki tameer ke waqiat mein Allah Ta'ala ki nemat aur bandon ki ita-at samne aati hai.
books.openingEnglish: The early life of Ismail Alaihis Salam is linked to the valley of Makkah. Zamzam, the settlement of the valley and the raising of the Kaaba’s foundations connect Allah’s gifts with obedience.

books.name: Ishaq Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Ishaq Alaihis Salam ki paidaish ki khushkhabri Quran mein bayan hai; exact tareekh aur bachpan ki mazeed tafseel nahi di gayi.

pages.title: Barhape mein khushkhabri
pages.roman:
Allah Ta'ala ke farishton ne Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ki biwi ko Ishaq Alaihis Salam, aur uske baad Yaqub Alaihis Salam ki khushkhabri di. Unhon ne apni aur shohar ki bari umar dekhkar hairat ki.

Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ke ghar aane wale farishte khushkhabri lekar aaye. Unki zawja ne apne aur apne shohar ke barhape par taajjub kiya. Jawab mein Allah Ta'ala ki rahmat aur barkaton ka zikr hua; yeh basharat aam insani andaaze se barh kar thi.
pages.english:
Allah’s messengers announced Ishaq Alaihis Salam and, after him, Yaqub Alaihis Salam. Ibrahim Alaihis Salam’s wife expressed astonishment at becoming a mother in old age.

The angels brought good news to Ibrahim Alaihis Salam's household. His wife expressed surprise at their old age. The answer directed attention to Allah's mercy and blessings beyond ordinary expectation.

pages.title: Nabuwat aur barkat
pages.roman:
Yeh basharat nabuwat aur barkat ke zikr ke saath bhi aati hai. Allah Ta'ala ne Ishaq Alaihis Salam ko saliheen mein se Nabi banne ki khushkhabri di aur Ibrahim Alaihis Salam aur Ishaq Alaihis Salam par barkat nazil ki.

Paidaish ki basharat ke baad Quran Ishaq Alaihis Salam ko nek Nabi ke taur par yaad karta hai. Barkat ka zikr Ibrahim Alaihis Salam aur un par saath aata hai. Nasal mein sab log ek jaise nahi: nek log aur khud par zulm karne wale alag bataye gaye hain.
pages.english:
Allah announced Ishaq Alaihis Salam as a prophet among the righteous and bestowed blessing upon Ibrahim Alaihis Salam and Ishaq Alaihis Salam.

After the good news, the Quran names Ishaq Alaihis Salam as a righteous prophet. Blessing is mentioned for him and Ibrahim Alaihis Salam, while descendants are distinguished by their deeds rather than ancestry alone.

pages.title: Neki aur ibadat ki rehnumai
pages.roman:
Is nemat ke saath rehnumai ki zimmedari bhi thi. Ishaq Alaihis Salam aur Yaqub Alaihis Salam ko Allah Ta'ala ne nek banaya aur rehnuma banaya. Unhein nek kaam, namaz qayam karne aur zakat dene ki wahi ki gayi.

Ishaq Alaihis Salam aur Yaqub Alaihis Salam ke zikr mein neki, namaz aur zakat ki rehnumai milti hai. Yahan kahani ka markaz unki zaati zindagi ke anjaane waqiat nahi, Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se di hui rehnumai hai. Isi had par bayan mukammal hota hai.
pages.english:
Allah made Ishaq Alaihis Salam and Yaqub Alaihis Salam righteous leaders, inspiring good deeds, prayer and charity. They worshipped Him. The account of Ishaq Alaihis Salam and Yaqub Alaihis Salam centres on leadership in good deeds, prayer and charity.

The story ends with the guidance Allah gave them.
pages.noteEnglish: Unrecorded private events are not supplied.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran announces Ishaq Alaihis Salam’s birth, but does not provide a precise date or detailed childhood here.
books.teaser: Barhape mein ek bete ki khushkhabri—aur uske saath Allah Ta'ala ki qudrat ka izhar.
books.openingRoman: Barhape mein ek bete ki khushkhabri—aur uske saath Allah Ta'ala ki qudrat ka izhar. Quran Ishaq Alaihis Salam ko nabuwat, neki aur barkat ke zikr ke saath yaad karta hai.
books.openingEnglish: The good news of a son in old age displayed Allah’s power. The Quran remembers Ishaq Alaihis Salam through prophethood, righteousness and blessing.

books.name: Yaqub Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Yaqub Alaihis Salam ki paidaish ki khushkhabri Ishaq Alaihis Salam ke baad Quran mein aati hai. Unke bachpan ki tafseel nahi di gayi.

pages.title: Khushkhabri aur rehnumai
pages.roman:
Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ke ghar Ishaq Alaihis Salam ke baad Yaqub Alaihis Salam ki khushkhabri di gayi. Allah Ta'ala ne Yaqub Alaihis Salam ko bhi neki aur hidayat se nawaza.

Unka naam pehle hi Ibrahim Alaihis Salam ke gharane ki basharat mein aata hai. Quran unhein rehnumai aur ibadat ke silsile se jorta hai. Aage unki kahani ek baap ki naseehat, lambi judai aur Allah Ta'ala se umeed ke saath samne aati hai.
pages.english:
Yaqub Alaihis Salam was announced after Ishaq Alaihis Salam in the glad tidings to Ibrahim Alaihis Salam’s household. Allah granted him righteousness and guidance.

His name appears in the good news given to Ibrahim Alaihis Salam's household. The Quran connects him with guidance and worship. His story then unfolds through a father's counsel, long separation and hope in Allah.

pages.title: Yusuf Alaihis Salam ka khwaab
pages.roman:
Yaqub Alaihis Salam aur unke bete Yusuf Alaihis Salam ka waqia ek khwaab se bhi jura hai. Yusuf Alaihis Salam ne apne walid Yaqub Alaihis Salam ko khwaab bataya. Yaqub Alaihis Salam ne samjhaya ke ise bhaiyon ke samne na bayan karein aur Allah Ta'ala ki ata ki basharat di.

Yaqub Alaihis Salam ne khwaab ki ahmiyat samjhi aur bete ko use bhaiyon se bayan na karne ki hidayat di. Woh jaante the ke hasad aur shaitan ki dushmani se bachna zaroori hai. Is naseehat ke baad gharane ka imtihan shuru hota hai.
pages.english:
Yusuf Alaihis Salam told Yaqub Alaihis Salam his dream. Yaqub Alaihis Salam advised him not to relate it to his brothers and spoke of Allah’s coming favour.

He recognised the significance of the dream and advised Yusuf Alaihis Salam not to tell his brothers. The warning concerned envy and Satan's hostility. A difficult trial for the household followed.
pages.titleEnglish: The Dream of Yusuf Alaihis Salam

pages.title: Judai aur sabr
pages.roman:
Phir judai ka gham unki zindagi mein aaya. Yusuf Alaihis Salam ke bhai ghalat khabar aur khoon laga qamees laye.

Yaqub Alaihis Salam ne sabr-e-jameel ikhtiyar kiya. Gham ke bawajood unhon ne Allah Ta'ala se umeed na chhori.

Bhaiyon ki khabar sun kar unhon ne sabr-e-jameel ka rasta ikhtiyar kiya. Baad ki judai aur gham mein bhi Allah Ta'ala ki rahmat se na-umeed hone ko nahi kaha. Unka dukh haqiqi tha, aur apne Rabb ki taraf rujoo bhi jari raha.
pages.english:
Yusuf Alaihis Salam’s brothers brought a bloodstained shirt and a false account. Yaqub Alaihis Salam chose beautiful patience and continued to hope in Allah.

He responded to the brothers' account with beautiful patience. Later grief did not lead him to abandon hope in Allah's mercy. His sorrow was real, while his turning towards Allah continued.

pages.title: Dobara mulaqat
pages.roman:
Lekin judai is kahani ka aakhri manzar nahi thi. Yusuf Alaihis Salam ki qamees aane par Yaqub Alaihis Salam ki basarat lauti. Baad mein ghar wale Yusuf Alaihis Salam ke paas pahunche aur judai ke baad mulaqat hui.

Qamees pahunchne aur basarat lautne ke baad Misr mein mulaqat ka waqt aaya. Yusuf Alaihis Salam ne apne walidain ko izzat di aur purane khwaab ka taalluq wazeh hua. Lambi judai ka silsila ab shukr aur Allah Ta'ala ki meherbani ke iqrar par pahunchta hai.
pages.english:
Yaqub Alaihis Salam’s sight returned when Yusuf Alaihis Salam’s shirt was brought to him. The family later reunited with Yusuf Alaihis Salam after their separation.

The arrival of the shirt and restoration of sight preceded the reunion in Egypt. Yusuf Alaihis Salam honoured his parents and explained the earlier dream. Long separation gave way to gratitude for Allah's kindness.

pages.title: Aakhri naseehat
pages.roman:
Yaqub Alaihis Salam ki zindagi ki aakhri naseehat bhi tawheed ki thi. Maut ke waqt Yaqub Alaihis Salam ne beton se poocha ke unke baad woh kiski ibadat karenge. Unhon ne ek Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat aur uski farmanbardari ka iqrar kiya.

Quran maut ke waqt ki naseehat ka zikr karta hai: aane wali nasal kis ki ibadat karegi? Jawab ek Allah Ta'ala ki bandagi ka tha. Yaqub Alaihis Salam ki kahani ke aakhir mein maal ya martaba nahi, tawheed ki wasiyyat samne aati hai.
pages.english:
As death approached, Yaqub Alaihis Salam asked his sons whom they would worship after him. They affirmed worship of the one God.

The Quran records his concern at the approach of death: whom would his children worship? Their answer affirmed the One God. His final concern in this account is faith rather than possessions or status.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran announces Yaqub Alaihis Salam after Ishaq Alaihis Salam. It does not provide a detailed childhood account here.
books.teaser: Yaqub Alaihis Salam ki kahani ek walid ki naseehat, judai ke sabr aur Allah Ta'ala se umeed ki kahani hai.
books.openingRoman: Yaqub Alaihis Salam ki kahani ek walid ki naseehat, judai ke sabr aur Allah Ta'ala se umeed ki kahani hai. Yusuf Alaihis Salam ka khwaab aur baad ki mulaqat is safar ke aham manzar hain.
books.openingEnglish: The story of Yaqub Alaihis Salam includes a father’s counsel, patience through separation and hope in Allah. The dream of Yusuf Alaihis Salam and their later reunion are important scenes in that account.

books.name: Yusuf Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Bachpan ka khwaab
pages.roman:
Yusuf Alaihis Salam ki kahani ek khwaab se shuru hoti hai. Unhon ne gyarah sitaron, suraj aur chand ko apne samne sajda karte dekha aur apne walid ko bataya.

Yaqub Alaihis Salam ne unhein yeh khwaab bhaiyon ke samne bayan na karne ki naseehat ki. Is khwaab ki tabeer kahani ke aakhri hisse mein samne aati hai.

Khwaab mein gyarah sitare, suraj aur chand ka sajda karna ek aisi baat thi jise Yaqub Alaihis Salam ne ahmiyat se liya. Magar us waqt uski poori tabeer samne nahi thi. Kahani isi ishare se shuru hoti hai aur kai azmaishon ke baad iska matlab khulta hai.
pages.english:
Young Yusuf Alaihis Salam told his father of a dream in which eleven stars, the sun and moon bowed to him. His father advised discretion.

The dream of eleven stars, the sun and moon was significant to Yaqub Alaihis Salam, but its full meaning was not yet visible. The story begins with this sign and returns to it after many trials.

pages.title: Bhaiyon ki tadbeer
pages.roman:
Bhaiyon ke dil mein Yusuf Alaihis Salam ke liye hasad tha. Unhon ne walid se Yusuf Alaihis Salam ko apne saath le jane ki ijazat li.

Lekin saath le jane ke baad unhein kuen mein daal diya. Ghar se nikla hua bachcha ab apne ghar walon se juda tha.
