Hasad ne bhaiyon ko judai ki tadbeer tak pahunchaya. Woh walid ko mutmain karke Yusuf Alaihis Salam ko le gaye aur kuen mein dal diya. Bachche ki be-basi ke darmiyan Allah Ta'ala ki wahi se aane wale din ki khabar di gayi.
pages.english:
Yusuf Alaihis Salam’s brothers acted out of jealousy. They obtained permission to take him with them and then cast him into a well.

Envy led the brothers to plan separation. After reassuring their father, they took Yusuf Alaihis Salam away and placed him in the well. In that helpless situation, revelation pointed towards a future encounter.

pages.title: Kuen se nikalna
pages.roman:
Bhai Yusuf Alaihis Salam ko kuen mein chhor gaye the. Wahan ek qafila aaya aur usne pani lane wala bheja. Usne dol dala to Yusuf Alaihis Salam ka pata chala.

Kuen se nikalne ke bawajood ghar ki judai khatam nahi hui. Unhein maal-e-tijarat samjha gaya aur kam qeemat par bech diya gaya. Ab unki kahani Misr ke ek naye ghar tak pahunchti hai.

Qafle ka pani lane wala aaya to use Yusuf Alaihis Salam mile. Unhein tijarat ka maal samajh kar chhupaya aur thori qeemat par bech diya gaya. Un logon ka andaaza unki asal izzat ka paimana nahi tha; kahani ab Misr ki taraf murti hai.
pages.english:
The brothers had left Yusuf Alaihis Salam in the well. A caravan arrived and sent its water carrier, who lowered his bucket and discovered him.

Leaving the well did not end his separation from home. He was treated as merchandise and sold for a small price. The story now moves towards a new household in Egypt.

A traveller drawing water found him. He was concealed as merchandise and sold for a small price. The sellers' valuation did not determine his worth; the story now moves towards Egypt.

pages.title: Misr mein nayi zindagi
pages.roman:
Misr mein jis shakhs ne Yusuf Alaihis Salam ko khareeda, us ne apni biwi ko unhein izzat se rakhne ko kaha. Yusuf Alaihis Salam ab ek naye ghar mein the.

Allah Ta'ala ne unhein zameen mein jagah di aur ilm ata kiya. Judai aur beche jane ke darmiyan bhi un par Allah Ta'ala ki ata ka silsila tha.

Misr ke kharidne wale ne apni zawja ko unhein izzat se rakhne ko kaha. Quran isi mor par Allah Ta'ala ki tadbeer ka zikr karta hai, halanke bahar se woh apne ghar se door the. Jawani mein unhein hikmat aur ilm diya gaya.
pages.english:
An Egyptian man bought Yusuf Alaihis Salam and instructed his wife to treat him honourably. Allah established Yusuf Alaihis Salam and granted him knowledge and judgment.

The Egyptian buyer instructed his wife to treat him honourably. The Quran points to Allah's purpose even while he was far from home. On reaching maturity he received judgement and knowledge.

pages.title: Gunah se panah
pages.roman:
Isi ghar mein Yusuf Alaihis Salam ko ek sakht azmaish pesh aayi. Ghar ki aurat ne unhein gunah ki taraf bulaya, lekin unhon ne Allah Ta'ala ki panah mangi. Darwaze tak pahunchne aur qamees phatne ka waqia hua.

Isi qamees ka haal unki begunahi ki daleel bana. Band darwazon ki azmaish mein unhon ne Allah Ta'ala ki panah mangi. Darwaze ki taraf barhne, qamees phatne aur gawahi ki tafseel se unki begunahi wazeh hoti hai.
pages.english:
The woman of the house tried to seduce Yusuf Alaihis Salam. He sought refuge in Allah, and the torn shirt became evidence supporting his innocence.

In the trial behind closed doors, he sought refuge in Allah. The torn shirt and testimony helped make the truth clear. The focus is his refusal of wrongdoing, not sensational detail.
pages.noteRoman: Is hisse ka markaz ghair-zaroori tasveer-kashi nahi, gunah se bachne ki koshish hai.

pages.title: Qaid ka intikhab
pages.roman:
Azmaish ke samne Yusuf Alaihis Salam ne apne Rabb se hifazat mangi. Gunah ki taraf bulaye jane ke muqable mein unhon ne qaid ko pasand kiya.

Phir unhein ek muddat ke liye qaid kar diya gaya. Unki kahani ka agla hissa ab qaidkhane mein pesh aata hai.

Dabao ek hi waqie par khatam nahi hua. Yusuf Alaihis Salam ne gunah ki taraf bulaye jane ke muqable mein qaid ko pasand kiya aur apne Rabb se madad mangi. Nishaniyan dekh lene ke bawajood unhein ek muddat ke liye qaid kar diya gaya.
pages.english:
Yusuf Alaihis Salam preferred imprisonment to the wrongdoing being urged upon him and prayed for protection. He was later imprisoned for a time.

The pressure did not end with one incident. He preferred imprisonment to the wrongdoing urged upon him and asked Allah for help. Despite the signs of his innocence, he was imprisoned for a time.

pages.title: Qaid mein dawat
pages.roman:
Qaidkhane mein Yusuf Alaihis Salam ke saath do jawan bhi the. Donon ne apne khwaab bataye aur unki tabeer poochhi.

Yusuf Alaihis Salam ne jawab ke saath unhein ek Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat ki taraf bulaya. Unhon ne wazeh kiya ke unka ilm unke Rabb ki ata hai. Phir donon ko unke khwaabon ki tabeer batayi. Qaid mein bhi unka paigham tawheed hi tha.

Do qaidiyon ke khwaabon ka jawab dene se pehle unhon ne tawheed samjhayi. Qaid ne unki dawat ko band nahi kiya. Jis qaid ko woh azmaish ke taur par jhel rahe the, usi mein baad ke waqiat ka ek zariya tayyar hua.
pages.english:
Two young men were in prison with Yusuf Alaihis Salam. Each described a dream and asked him to explain its meaning.

Yusuf Alaihis Salam called them to worship Allah alone and made clear that his knowledge was a gift from his Lord. He then explained their dreams. Even in prison, his message remained the worship of Allah alone.

Before interpreting the prisoners' dreams, he spoke about worshipping Allah alone. Imprisonment did not end his mission. Within that trial, a connection was formed that would matter later in the story.

pages.title: Badshah ka khwaab
pages.roman:
Phir badshah ke khwaab ka sawal Yusuf Alaihis Salam tak pahuncha. Unhon ne saat saal kasrat se kheti, uske baad saat sakht saal aur phir farakhi ki khabar di.

Qaid mein maujood Yusuf Alaihis Salam ne aane wale saalon ke liye tadbeer bhi samjhayi. Unka ilm ek badi zaroorat ke waqt samne aaya.

Pehle qaidiyon ke khwaab the, ab hukmaran ka khwaab samne aaya. Yusuf Alaihis Salam ne aane wale saalon ke liye fasal bachane aur tadbeer karne ki hidayat di. Khwaab ki tabeer sirf khabar nahi, logon ki zarurat ki tayyari se jur gayi.
pages.english:
Yusuf Alaihis Salam interpreted the king’s dream: seven years of cultivation, followed by seven hard years, then a year of relief.

The ruler's dream brought the earlier connection back into the story. Yusuf Alaihis Salam explained the coming years and the need to preserve crops. The interpretation was joined with practical preparation for people's needs.

pages.title: Begunahi wazeh hui
pages.roman:
Riha hone ka mauqa aaya, lekin Yusuf Alaihis Salam ne pehle apne upar lage ilzam ki tehqeeq mangi. Auraton ne unki begunahi tasleem ki.

Aziz ki biwi ne bhi apni ghalati ka iqrar kiya. Yusuf Alaihis Salam ka qaid se nikalna unki begunahi wazeh hone ke saath tha.

Rihaai ka paigham aane par unhon ne apne muamle ki tahqiq chahi. Unki begunahi ka iqrar hua aur sach chhupne na diya gaya. Qaid se nikalne ka yeh mor izzat aur amanat ke saath nayi zimmedari ki taraf khulta hai.
pages.english:
Before leaving prison, Yusuf Alaihis Salam requested an investigation. The women acknowledged his innocence, and the wife of the Aziz admitted her wrongdoing.

When release was offered, he asked for the case to be investigated. His innocence was acknowledged. The transition from prison to public responsibility was therefore accompanied by a clear statement of the truth.

pages.title: Amanat ki zimmedari
pages.roman:
Badshah ne Yusuf Alaihis Salam ko maqam aur aitimad diya. Yusuf Alaihis Salam ne zameen ke khazanon ki zimmedari mangi aur apni hifazat aur ilm ka zikr kiya.

Allah Ta'ala ne unhein ikhtiyar ata kiya. Qaidkhane se unki zindagi ab zimmedari ke ek naye marhale tak pahunchi.

Unhon ne khazanon ki zimmedari ke liye apni hifazat aur ilm ka zikr kiya. Quran batata hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne unhein zameen mein maqam diya. Kuen ki judai aur qaid ki azmaish ke baad ab doosron ke liye zimmedari ka daur samne tha.
pages.english:
The king honoured Yusuf Alaihis Salam. Yusuf Alaihis Salam asked to oversee the storehouses, citing his trustworthiness and knowledge, and Allah established him in authority.

He mentioned his knowledge and ability to safeguard the storehouses. Allah gave him an established position in the land. After separation and imprisonment, the account now turns to responsibility for others.

pages.title: Bhaiyon se dobara mulaqat
pages.roman:
Qahat ke dino mein ghalla lene kuch log Misr aaye—yeh Yusuf Alaihis Salam ke bhai the. Unhon ne Yusuf Alaihis Salam ko na pehchana, magar Yusuf Alaihis Salam unhein pehchan gaye.

Baad ke safar mein unka saga bhai bhi saath aaya. Bachpan ki judai se jura waqia ab dobara ghar walon ki taraf laut raha tha.

Bhai rizq ki zarurat ke liye aaye aur unhein pehchan na sake, jabke Yusuf Alaihis Salam ne unhein pehchan liya. Muamla foran pehchan khol dene par khatam nahi hua. Chhote bhai ko lane ki darkhwast ne gharane ko dobara is kahani mein jor diya.
pages.english:
Yusuf Alaihis Salam’s brothers came for provisions without recognizing him, though he recognized them. On a later visit, his brother also came.

The brothers came seeking supplies without recognising him, though he recognised them. His identity was not immediately disclosed. The request to bring their younger brother drew the household back into the story.

pages.title: Chhote bhai ka theharna
pages.roman:
Chhote bhai ki amad ke baad anaj diya gaya aur pyala unke samaan mein rakh diya gaya. Phir gum-shuda pyale ki talash ka muamla utha. Bhaiyon ke apne bataye hue qanoon ke mutabiq jis ke samaan mein pyala milta, use rok liya jata.

Talashi ke baad chhota bhai Misr mein thehar gaya. Quran is tadbeer ko Allah Ta'ala ki rehnumai ke saath bayan karta hai. Is naye mor se bhaiyon ko apne walid ke samne kiye hue wade ki fikr hui. Kahani ab unke ghar lautne aur dobara aane ke darmiyan ek mushkil marhale se guzarti hai.
pages.english:
After the younger brother arrived, a cup was placed in his baggage. The search and the rule stated by the brothers led to him remaining in Egypt.

The Quran connects the plan with Allah's guidance. The brothers now faced the difficulty of the promise they had made to their father. Their return home became a painful stage before the later reunion.

pages.title: Umeed abhi baqi thi
pages.roman:
Bhaiyon mein sabse bare ne apne walid ki ijazat ya Allah Ta'ala ke faisle tak wahan rukne ka irada kiya. Doosre bhai Yaqub Alaihis Salam ke paas khabar lekar pahunche. Pehle Yusuf Alaihis Salam ki judai thi; ab chhote bhai ki khabar ne gham aur gehra kar diya.

Phir bhi Yaqub Alaihis Salam ne Allah Ta'ala se umeed nahi chhori. Unhon ne beton ko Yusuf Alaihis Salam aur unke bhai ki talaash karne aur Allah Ta'ala ki rahmat se na-umeed na hone ko kaha. Isi hidayat ke saath dobara Misr ka rasta khulta hai.
pages.english:
The eldest resolved to remain until his father permitted him or Allah decided. The others returned with news that deepened Yaqub Alaihis Salam's grief.

Yet he did not abandon hope. He instructed his sons to seek Yusuf Alaihis Salam and his brother and not despair of Allah's mercy. That instruction leads directly towards their return to Egypt and the disclosure of the truth.

pages.title: Pehchan aur maafi
pages.roman:
Aakhir Yusuf Alaihis Salam ne apni pehchan zahir kar di. Bhaiyon ne apni ghalati tasleem ki.

Yusuf Alaihis Salam ne un par us din malamat na karne ki baat kahi aur Allah Ta'ala se maghfirat ki dua ki. Badla lene ke is mauqe par unki taraf se maafi samne aayi.

Jab sach samne aaya to bhaiyon ne apni ghalati ka iqrar kiya. Yusuf Alaihis Salam ne us din malamat na karne aur Allah Ta'ala ki maghfirat ki baat ki. Iqtidar ke is lamhe ko intiqam mein badalne ke bajaye maafi ka rasta ikhtiyar hua.
pages.english:
Yusuf Alaihis Salam revealed his identity. His brothers admitted their wrongdoing, and he declined to reproach them, praying for their forgiveness.

Once the truth became known, the brothers admitted their wrongdoing. Yusuf Alaihis Salam spoke of forgiveness rather than reproach. His position of power became an occasion for mercy, not revenge.

pages.title: Ghar walon ki mulaqat
pages.roman:
Yusuf Alaihis Salam ne apni qamees walid ke paas bheji. Phir ghar wale Misr pahunche aur judai ke baad mulaqat hui.

Yusuf Alaihis Salam ne apne bachpan ke khwaab ki tabeer poori hone ko pehchana. Kuen, qaid aur lambi judai ke baad unhon ne is anjaam ko apne Rabb ki meherbani kaha.

Aakhir mein bachpan ke khwaab ka taalluq samne aaya. Yusuf Alaihis Salam ne apne Rabb ki meherbani ka iqrar kiya aur nek logon ke saath milaye jane ki dua ki. Kahani martabe par nahi, shukr aur achhe anjaam ki darkhwast par mukammal hoti hai.
pages.english:
Yusuf Alaihis Salam sent his shirt to his father, and the family came to Egypt. He recognized the fulfilment of his childhood dream as Allah’s kindness.

The childhood dream was finally understood. Yusuf Alaihis Salam acknowledged Allah's kindness and prayed to be joined with the righteous. The story ends with gratitude and a prayer for a good end rather than with status alone.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Ek khwaab, ghar se judai, Misr mein azmaish aur phir mulaqat.
books.openingRoman: Ek khwaab, ghar se judai, Misr mein azmaish aur phir mulaqat. Yusuf Alaihis Salam ki kahani ke marhale ek doosre se jurte hain, aur aakhir mein bachpan ke khwaab ki tabeer samne aati hai.
books.openingEnglish: A dream, separation from home, trials in Egypt and a reunion form the connected story of Yusuf Alaihis Salam. Its later events reveal the fulfilment of his childhood dream.

books.name: Ayyub Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Takleef mein dua
pages.roman:
Ayyub Alaihis Salam ko takleef pahunchi. Unhon ne apne Rabb ko pukara aur uski rahmat ka zikr kiya. Takleef ka zikr apne Rabb ke samne kiya gaya, lekin Allah Ta'ala ki rahmat se na-umeedi ka izhar nahi hua.

Ayyub Alaihis Salam ki dua mein apni kamzori aur Rabb ki rahmat dono saath aate hain. Yahin se kahani takleef se rahat ki taraf barhti hai.
pages.english:
Ayyub Alaihis Salam suffered affliction and called upon his Lord, appealing to His mercy. Unestablished graphic descriptions of illness are not added.

His prayer placed his suffering before Allah without giving up hope in His mercy. It joined acknowledgement of weakness with trust in the Most Merciful. The account then turns towards relief.
pages.noteRoman: Bemari ki ghair-sabit, khaufnaak tafseel yahan nahi jori gayi.

pages.title: Pani aur shifa
pages.roman:
Dua ke is waqie mein shifa ka zikr bhi aata hai. Allah Ta'ala ne Ayyub Alaihis Salam ko zameen par paon marne ka hukm diya aur thanda pani nahane aur peene ke liye ata kiya.

Unhein pair se zameen par marne ka hukm hua aur thande pani se ghusl aur peene ka zariya mila. Quran yahan bimari ka naam ya tamam saalon ki tafseel nahi deta. Bayan us madad ko markaz banata hai jo Allah Ta'ala ne ata ki.
pages.english: Allah instructed Ayyub Alaihis Salam to strike the ground with his foot and provided cool water for washing and drinking. He was instructed to strike the ground with his foot, and cool water was provided for washing and drinking. It centres on Allah's help.
pages.noteEnglish: The passage does not name every detail of the illness or its duration.

pages.title: Rahmat aur ghar wale
pages.roman:
Allah Ta'ala ki rahmat mein unke ghar walon ki nemat bhi thi. Allah Ta'ala ne unki takleef door ki aur unhein unke ghar wale aur unke saath utne hi mazeed ata kiye. Quran ise rahmat aur ibadat karne walon ke liye yaad-dihani kehta hai.

Dua ke jawab mein takleef door ki gayi aur gharane ki nemat dobara ata hui. Quran isko ibadat karne walon ke liye yaad-dihani kehta hai. Rahat ka yeh hissa pehli dua se jura hai; Rabb ne apne bande ki pukar suni.
pages.english:
Allah removed Ayyub Alaihis Salam’s affliction and restored his family, with as many more, as mercy and a reminder for worshippers.

The removal of suffering and restoration of family blessing answer the earlier prayer. The Quran presents it as a reminder for worshippers. Relief is connected with the servant's turning towards Allah.

pages.title: Sabr karne wala banda
pages.roman:
Quran is bande ki pehchan sabr ke saath karata hai. Allah Ta'ala ne Ayyub Alaihis Salam ki tareef sabr karne wale aur behtareen bande ke taur par farmayi jo uski taraf rujoo karta tha. Unki kahani mein dard ke saath dua aur sabr ka zikr hai.

Allah Ta'ala ne unki tareef sabr karne wale aur baar-baar apni taraf rujoo karne wale bande ke taur par farmayi. Is tareef ke saath waqia mukammal hota hai. Unki azmaish ki har anjaani tafseel ko bharna zaroori nahi; sabit baat unka sabr aur Rabb se taalluq hai.
pages.english:
Allah praised Ayyub Alaihis Salam as patient, an excellent servant who repeatedly turned to Him. His account joins suffering with prayer and perseverance. Allah praised him as patient and constantly turning back to Him.

The account ends with this description.
pages.noteEnglish: Unrecorded details need not be supplied; patience and his relationship with Allah remain its established centre.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Takleef ke waqt Ayyub Alaihis Salam ne apne Rabb ko pukara.
books.openingRoman: Takleef ke waqt Ayyub Alaihis Salam ne apne Rabb ko pukara. Quran ki mukhtasar magar gehri riwayat mein dua, shifa aur Allah Ta'ala ki rahmat ka zikr hai.
books.openingEnglish: In affliction, Ayyub Alaihis Salam called upon his Lord. The Quran’s concise account brings together supplication, healing and Allah’s mercy.

books.name: Shuayb Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Madyan ki taraf paigham
pages.roman:
Shuayb Alaihis Salam ne Madyan ko Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat aur naap-tol mein insaf ki dawat di. Unhon ne logon ka haq kam karne aur zameen mein fasad se roka.

Madyan ki taraf dawat mein Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat aur logon ke huqooq saath aaye. Naap aur tol mein kami se doosron ka maal kam karna unki rawish thi. Shuayb Alaihis Salam ne samjhaya ke khushhali zulm ko jaiz nahi banati.
pages.english:
Shuayb Alaihis Salam called Madyan to worship Allah, give full measure and weight, and refrain from cheating people and spreading corruption.

The call to Madyan joined worship of Allah with the rights of people. Short measure deprived others of their property. Prosperity did not make that injustice acceptable.

pages.title: Tijarat mein diyanat
pages.roman:
Unki dawat tijarat aur rozmarrah muamlaat tak bhi thi. Unhon ne kaha ke Allah Ta'ala ka diya hua halal baqiya unke liye behtar hai. Maqsad sirf apni istitaat ke mutabiq islah tha, aur bharosa Allah Ta'ala par tha.

Unhon ne apni baat ko zaati faide ka dawa nahi banaya. Islah chahna aur Allah Ta'ala par bharosa rakhna unke jawab ka markaz tha. Jis amal se woh logon ko rok rahe the, khud uske khilaf chalna unka maqsad nahi tha.
pages.english:
He taught that what Allah left lawfully was better. He sought reform as far as he could and relied upon Allah.

His response centred on reform and trust in Allah rather than personal gain. He did not seek to practise the very wrongdoing he forbade. The message joined honest conduct with sincere guidance.

pages.title: Qaum ki dhamki
pages.roman:
Magar qaum ke sardaron ka jawab dhamki tha. Qaum ke takabbur wale sardaron ne Shuayb Alaihis Salam aur iman walon ko nikalne ki dhamki di. Shuayb Alaihis Salam ne Allah Ta'ala par tawakkul kiya aur usse faisla manga.

Qaum ke sardaron ne iman walon ko apne tareeqe par lautne ya basti se nikalne ki dhamki di. Daulat ke muamle ka inkar ab dawat ke khilaf dabao ban gaya. Shuayb Alaihis Salam ne Allah Ta'ala se haq ke saath faisle ki dua ki.
pages.english:
Arrogant leaders threatened to expel Shuayb Alaihis Salam and the believers. He placed his trust in Allah and asked Him to judge.

The leaders threatened the believers with return to their ways or expulsion. Rejection became open pressure against the mission. Shuayb Alaihis Salam turned to Allah for a judgement in truth.

pages.title: Inkar aur anjaam
pages.roman:
Is inkar ka anjaam bhi Quran bayan karta hai. Qaum ne inkar jari rakha. Allah Ta'ala ne Shuayb Alaihis Salam aur iman walon ko apni rahmat se bachaya aur zalimon ko azab ne aa liya.

Tanbeeh ke bawajood zidd jari rahi aur phir azab ka hukm aaya. Shuayb Alaihis Salam aur unke saath iman lane wale Allah Ta'ala ki rahmat se bachaye gaye. Pehle tijarat ki khushhali thi; aakhir mein wahi basti unke zulm se aman na de saki.
pages.english:
The people continued to reject the message. Allah saved Shuayb Alaihis Salam and the believers through His mercy, while punishment overtook the wrongdoers.

Their persistence was followed by punishment. Shuayb Alaihis Salam and the believers were saved by Allah's mercy. The prosperous settlement could not protect those who persisted in injustice.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Shuayb Alaihis Salam ki dawat ibadat ke saath logon ke huqooq se bhi juri thi.
books.openingRoman: Shuayb Alaihis Salam ki dawat ibadat ke saath logon ke huqooq se bhi juri thi. Madyan ke logon ko naap-tol poora karne aur zameen mein fasad se bachne ki naseehat ki gayi.
books.openingEnglish: The call of Shuayb Alaihis Salam concerned worship and people’s rights. The people of Madyan were told to give full measure and weight and avoid corruption.

books.name: Musa Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Musa Alaihis Salam ki paidaish aur bachpan ka waqia Quran mein bayan hai. Exact tareekh is account mein nahi di gayi.

pages.title: Zulm ke daur mein paidaish
pages.roman:
Musa Alaihis Salam ki kahani zulm ke daur mein shuru hoti hai. Firaun logon ko girohon mein baantkar ek giroh ke beton ko qatl karwata tha.

Isi khatre ke darmiyan Allah Ta'ala ne Musa Alaihis Salam ki walida ko unhein doodh pilane aur khatra ho to darya mein rakhne ki hidayat di. Unki hifazat ka waqia yahin se aage barhta hai.

Firaun ne logon ko girohon mein baant rakha tha aur ek giroh ke beton ko qatl karata tha. Isi zulm ke darmiyan Allah Ta'ala ne Musa Alaihis Salam ki walida ko bachche ki hifazat ke liye hidayat di. Kahani ka aaghaz insani zulm aur Allah Ta'ala ke wade ke is farq se hota hai.
pages.english:
Pharaoh oppressed a group of people and killed their sons. Allah guided Musa Alaihis Salam’s mother to nurse him and, when afraid, place him in the river.

Pharaoh divided the people and killed the sons of an oppressed group. Within this setting, Allah guided the mother of Musa Alaihis Salam concerning her child. The opening contrasts oppression with Allah's promise.
pages.titleEnglish: Born in a Time of Oppression

pages.title: Darya se mahal tak
pages.roman:
Sanduq mein rakhe Musa Alaihis Salam darya tak pahunche. Phir Firaun ke ghar walon ne unhein utha liya.

Firaun ki biwi ne unhein qatl na karne ko kaha. Jis daur mein bachchon ki jaan ko khatra tha, Musa Alaihis Salam Firaun ke ghar tak pahunchaye gaye.

Jis gharane se khatra tha, bachcha usi ke mahal tak pahunch gaya. Firaun ki zawja ne use qatl na karne ko kaha. Bahar se yeh safar be-basi ka lagta tha, magar Quran is mein Allah Ta'ala ki nigrani aur hifazat ka zikr karta hai.
pages.english:
Musa Alaihis Salam was placed in a chest in the river and taken in by Pharaoh’s household. Pharaoh’s wife pleaded that he should not be killed.

The child reached the household from which danger had come. Pharaoh's wife urged that he not be killed. What appeared to be helpless movement was nevertheless under Allah's care.
pages.titleEnglish: From the River to the Palace

pages.title: Walida ki god mein wapsi
pages.roman:
Udhar Musa Alaihis Salam ki behen door se unki khabar leti rahi. Allah Ta'ala ne Musa Alaihis Salam ko doosri doodh pilane waliyon se roka.

Phir aisa sabab bana ke woh apni walida tak wapas pahunch gaye. Allah Ta'ala ne unki walida ki aankh thandi ki; judai ke baad bachcha phir unki god mein tha.

Unki behen door se khabar leti rahi. Jab bachche ne doosri doodh pilane wali auraton ko qabool nahi kiya to walida ke paas lautne ka zariya bana. Allah Ta'ala ka wada poora hua aur maa ko tasalli mili ke uske Rabb ki baat sach hai.
pages.english:
Musa Alaihis Salam’s sister watched from a distance. Allah prevented him from accepting other wet nurses and reunited him with his mother.

His sister followed the situation from a distance. His refusal of other nursing women became the means of returning him to his mother. Allah fulfilled His promise and reassured her.

pages.title: Jawani aur ek ghalati
pages.roman:
Musa Alaihis Salam ko jawani mein hikmat aur ilm ata hua. Ek din shehar mein jhagra dekha to unhon ne ek shakhs ko mukka mara aur woh mar gaya.

Musa Alaihis Salam ne apni ghalati par Allah Ta'ala se maafi mangi. Unki zindagi ab ek aur mushkil mor par thi.

Ladai mein mudakhalat karte hue unke ek vaar se aadmi mar gaya. Musa Alaihis Salam ne apni ghalati ka iqrar karke maghfirat mangi. Allah Ta'ala ki di hui quwwat ka zikr yahan apne aap ko be-ghalati qarar dene ka sabab nahi bana.
pages.english:
As an adult, Musa Alaihis Salam received wisdom and knowledge. During a quarrel he struck a man who died, then sought Allah’s forgiveness.

A man died after Musa Alaihis Salam intervened in a fight. He acknowledged his wrong and sought forgiveness. The strength Allah had given him did not lead him to deny responsibility.

pages.title: Madyan ki taraf safar
pages.roman:
Jab khatre ki khabar mili to Musa Alaihis Salam shehar se nikal gaye. Unhon ne Allah Ta'ala se zalim logon se nijat aur seedhe raste ki dua ki.

Unka safar Madyan ki taraf tha. Peechhe khatra tha aur aage ke safar mein unka rujoo apne Rabb ki taraf tha.

Agli baar khabar mili ke sardaar unke qatl ka mashwara kar rahe hain. Woh khauf aur ehtiyat ke saath shehar se nikle aur Allah Ta'ala se zalim logon se nijat mangi. Madyan ki taraf rukh karte waqt bhi unki umeed Rabb ki rehnumai se thi.
pages.english:
Warned of danger, Musa Alaihis Salam left the city and prayed for deliverance and guidance as he travelled toward Madyan.

On learning that the leaders were plotting against him, he left the city cautiously and prayed for rescue. As he headed towards Madyan, he hoped for his Lord's guidance.

pages.title: Pani par madad
pages.roman:
Madyan ke pani par Musa Alaihis Salam ne do auraton ko dekha aur unki madad ki. Unke liye pani pilane ke baad woh saaye mein aa gaye.

Wahan unhon ne Allah Ta'ala se apni zaroorat ki dua ki. Zaroorat ke is waqt bhi unhon ne pehle doosron ka kaam kiya.

Kuen par do auratein apne janwaron ko roke khari thin. Musa Alaihis Salam ne unke liye pani pilaya, phir saaye mein jakar apni zarurat Rabb ke samne rakhi. Unke apne mushkil safar ne unhein doosron ki madad se nahi roka.
pages.english:
At Madyan’s water, Musa Alaihis Salam helped two women water their flock. He then rested in the shade and prayed to Allah in need.

At the well, two women were holding their animals back. He helped water them, then withdrew to the shade and placed his own need before Allah. His hardship did not prevent him from helping others.

pages.title: Aman aur ghar ki zindagi
pages.roman:
Un auraton ke walid ne Musa Alaihis Salam ko aman ki khabar di. Yahan unki shadi aur aath ya das saal ki khidmat ka muahida hua. Shehar se nikle Musa Alaihis Salam ko ab aman aur ghar ki zindagi mili.

Quran un buzurg ka naam nahi batata. Jis ghar mein unhein bulaya gaya, wahan apna waqia sunane par aman ki tasalli mili. Kaam aur nikah ka muamla tay hua.
pages.english:
Their father reassured Musa Alaihis Salam. An agreement involved marriage and eight or ten years of service. The household that invited him reassured him of safety after hearing his account.

Work and marriage were agreed.
pages.noteRoman: Quran us buzurg ka naam yahan nahi batata; is liye use kisi Nabi ka naam yaqini taur par nahi diya gaya.
pages.noteEnglish: The Quran does not name this elder. The Quran does not name the elder here, so this retelling does not identify him as a particular prophet.

pages.title: Aag ke paas nida
pages.roman:
Muddat poori hui to Musa Alaihis Salam apne ghar walon ke saath rawana hue. Raste mein aag dekhi aur uski taraf gaye.

Yahin Allah Ta'ala ki nida aayi aur unhein nabuwat ki zimmedari aur nishaniyan di gayin. Safar ka yeh marhala Allah Ta'ala ke paigham ki zimmedari ka marhala ban gaya.

Muqarrar muddat ke baad ghar walon ke saath safar mein aag nazar aayi. Wahan Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se nida aur rasalat ki zimmedari mili. Yahi safar pehle aman ki talaash tha; ab Firaun ke paas paigham lekar lautne ki zimmedari ban gaya.
pages.english:
After completing the term, Musa Alaihis Salam travelled with his family. Seeing a fire, he approached and received Allah’s call and signs.

After the agreed period, he saw a fire while travelling with his family. There he received Allah's call and the responsibility of messengership. His journey now led towards returning to Pharaoh with a message.

pages.title: Harun Alaihis Salam ki madad ki dua
pages.roman:
Is zimmedari ke liye Musa Alaihis Salam ne apne Rabb se madad mangi. Unhon ne seena kholne, kaam aasaan karne aur zaban ki girah kholne ki dua ki.

Apne bhai Harun Alaihis Salam ko madadgar banane ki darkhwast bhi ki. Allah Ta'ala ne unki yeh darkhwast qubool ki.

Unhon ne apne seene ki kushadgi, kaam ki aasani aur baat ke samjhe jane ki dua ki. Bhai ki madad ki darkhwast bhi usi mission ke liye thi. Allah Ta'ala ne unki dua qubool ki, aur dono bhaiyon ki mushtarka zimmedari samne aayi.
pages.english:
Musa Alaihis Salam prayed for ease, clear speech and help from his brother Harun Alaihis Salam. Allah granted his request.

He prayed for an open heart, ease in his task and speech that could be understood. His request for his brother's help served the same mission. Allah granted it, bringing both brothers into the task.
pages.titleEnglish: A Prayer for Harun Alaihis Salam’s Support

pages.title: Firaun ke samne dawat
pages.roman:
Ab Musa Alaihis Salam aur Harun Alaihis Salam ko Firaun ke paas jana tha. Hukm yeh tha ke usse narmi se baat karein.

Unhon ne Allah Ta'ala ki nishaniyan pesh kin aur Bani Israil ko apne saath jane dene ka mutalaba kiya. Zulm ke samne Allah Ta'ala ka paigham pahunchaya gaya.

Dono ko narmi se baat karne ka hukm mila, halanke samne zalim hukmaran tha. Unhon ne Bani Israil ko saath jane dene aur Allah Ta'ala ki nishaniyon ka paigham diya. Quwwat ka dawa karne wale darbar mein ab haq ki dawat samne thi.
pages.english:
Musa Alaihis Salam and Harun Alaihis Salam were sent to address Pharaoh gently, ask him to release the Israelites and present Allah’s signs.

They were commanded to speak gently despite facing a tyrant. They conveyed Allah's signs and asked that Bani Israil be allowed to leave. The royal court was confronted with a call to truth.

pages.title: Jadugaron ka iman
pages.roman:
Muqable ka waqt aaya to Musa Alaihis Salam ki nishani ne jadugaron ka banaya hua dhoka mita diya. Jadugar Allah Ta'ala par iman le aaye.

Firaun ne unhein dhamkiyan din, lekin woh apne iman par qaim rahe. Muqable ke is manzar mein haq ko pehchanne walon ka faisla samne aa gaya.

Jadugaron ne jo dekha use apne hunar ka muqabla nahi samjha aur iman le aaye. Firaun ki dhamki ke bawajood unhon ne apne Rabb ki taraf lautne ko tarjeeh di. Jis majme se inkar mazboot karna chaha gaya tha, wahin iman ka iqrar hua.
pages.english:
At the contest, the sign given to Musa Alaihis Salam overcame the magicians’ deception. They believed and remained firm despite Pharaoh’s threats.

The magicians recognised that what they saw was not a contest of their craft and believed. Pharaoh's threats did not reverse that decision. A gathering meant to reinforce rejection became a scene of belief.

pages.title: Sakhti aur nishaniyan
pages.roman:
Firaun ki qaum par nishaniyan aur sakhtiyan aati rahin. Woh azab hatne par apna wada tor dete the.

Aakhir Bani Israil ko raat mein nikalne ka hukm mila. Ab qaum ko zulm se nikalne ka safar darpesh tha.

Bar-bar ki nishaniyon ke bawajood Firaun ki qaum apne wade todti rahi. Har sakhti ke baad nijat ki darkhwast hoti, phir inkar laut aata. Aakhir Musa Alaihis Salam ko bandon ko raat mein le nikalne ka hukm hua.
pages.english:
Pharaoh’s people experienced signs and afflictions, yet broke their promises after relief. The Israelites were eventually commanded to depart by night.

Repeated signs were followed by broken promises. Relief from hardship did not produce lasting obedience. Eventually Musa Alaihis Salam was instructed to lead the servants out by night.

pages.title: Samandar mein rasta
pages.roman:
Safar mein ek sakht manzar samne aaya: peechhe Firaun ka lashkar tha aur aage samandar. Musa Alaihis Salam ne apne Rabb ki rehnumai par yaqeen zahir kiya.

Allah Ta'ala ke hukm se samandar phata aur rasta ban gaya. Jahan rasta nazar nahi aa raha tha, Allah Ta'ala ne rasta ata kiya.

Peechhe Firaun ka lashkar aur samne samandar tha. Saathiyon ko pakre jane ka khauf hua, lekin Musa Alaihis Salam ne apne Rabb ki rehnumai ka yaqeen zahir kiya. Asa marne ke hukm ke baad samandar mein rasta khul gaya.
pages.english:
With Pharaoh’s army behind and the sea ahead, Musa Alaihis Salam trusted Allah’s guidance. At Allah’s command the sea parted and a path opened.

With Pharaoh's forces behind and the sea ahead, his companions feared capture. Musa Alaihis Salam affirmed trust in his Lord's guidance. At Allah's command, the sea opened a path.

pages.title: Nijat aur Firaun ka anjaam
pages.roman:
Allah Ta'ala ne Musa Alaihis Salam aur unke saath walon ko bacha liya. Unke peechhe aane walon ko gharaq kar diya gaya.

Samandar ke waqie mein nijat aur Firaun ka anjaam dono samne aaye. Quran ise ek badi nishani ke taur par bayan karta hai.

Musa Alaihis Salam aur unke saath walon ko bachaya gaya, jabke Firaun apne lashkar ke saath doob gaya. Doobte waqt ka iqrar pehle zulm aur inkar ka badal nahi bana. Nijat ke baad qaum ki zindagi mein nayi zimmedariyan aane wali thin.
pages.english:
Allah saved Musa Alaihis Salam and those with him, while the pursuing forces drowned. The Quran describes this as a sign.

Musa Alaihis Salam and those with him were rescued, while Pharaoh drowned with his forces. His final declaration did not erase the earlier rejection and oppression. New responsibilities followed the people's rescue.

pages.title: Toor par wahi
pages.roman:
Quran Musa Alaihis Salam ki zindagi mein wahi aur rehnumai ka ek aur aham marhala bayan karta hai. Woh apne Rabb ki muqarrar muddat ke liye gaye aur Harun Alaihis Salam ko qaum mein apna naib banaya. Allah Ta'ala ne Musa Alaihis Salam se kalam kiya aur takhtiyon mein naseehat aur ahkam ata kiye.

Muqarrar muddat ke liye jate waqt Musa Alaihis Salam ne Harun Alaihis Salam ko qaum ki zimmedari di. Toor ka waqia Allah Ta'ala ki jalalat aur wahi ki zimmedari ko samne lata hai. Rehnumai ki alwah milne ke baad unki pairwi ka imtihan tha.
pages.english:
Musa Alaihis Salam left Harun Alaihis Salam in charge during an appointed absence. Allah spoke to Musa Alaihis Salam and gave instruction and guidance on the tablets.

Before leaving for the appointed meeting, he entrusted the people to Harun Alaihis Salam. The event at the mountain centres on Allah's majesty and revelation. Receiving guidance also brought the responsibility to follow it.

pages.title: Bachhre ki azmaish
pages.roman:
Musa Alaihis Salam ki ghair-hazri mein qaum ke kuch log bachhre ki ibadat mein par gaye. Harun Alaihis Salam ne unhein is se roka tha.

Musa Alaihis Salam wapas aaye to qaum ki is sarkashi par sakht ranj zahir kiya. Allah Ta'ala ki nishaniyan dekhne ke baad bhi qaum ek badi azmaish mein pari.

Nijat ki nishaniyan dekhne wali qaum mein bhi gumrahi ka waqia hua. Musa Alaihis Salam laut kar sakht ranjida hue aur muamle ki tahqiq ki. Harun Alaihis Salam ne qaum ko pehle hi roka tha; tawheed ki taraf wapsi zaroori thi.
pages.english:
During Musa Alaihis Salam’s absence, some people worshipped the calf. Harun Alaihis Salam had warned them, and Musa Alaihis Salam returned deeply distressed by their wrongdoing.

Even after the signs of rescue, some fell into worship of the calf. Musa Alaihis Salam returned in distress and investigated. Harun Alaihis Salam had warned them; a return to worshipping Allah alone was necessary.

pages.title: Safar mein pani aur rizq
pages.roman:
Quran isi qaum par Allah Ta'ala ki nematon ka zikr bhi karta hai. Pani manga gaya to chattan se barah chashme nikle.

Har giroh ne apna pani peene ka maqam pehchan liya. Unke safar mein pani aur rizq bhi Allah Ta'ala ki ata the.

Khane, saaye aur pani ki nematein safar ke darmiyan milin. Pani ke liye har giroh ko apna chashma maloom hua. Quran in nematon ke saath shukr aur nafarmani ka farq bhi yaad dilata hai; nijat ke baad bhi bandagi ki zarurat khatam nahi hui.
pages.english:
Allah provided for Musa Alaihis Salam’s people. When they sought water, twelve springs emerged from the rock and each group knew its drinking place.

Food, shade and water were provided during the journey. Each group knew its drinking place. The gifts called for gratitude; rescue did not remove the need for obedience.
pages.titleEnglish: Water and Provision on the Journey

pages.title: Ilm ke safar ki seekh
pages.roman:
Musa Alaihis Salam ki zindagi ka ilm se jura ek aur safar Surah Al-Kahf mein aata hai. Woh Allah Ta'ala ke ek bande ke saath chale.

Kashti, ek ladke aur deewar ke waqiat pesh aaye, jin ki hikmat baad mein kholi gayi. Yeh safar yaad dilata hai ke insaan ka ilm mehdood hai.

Is safar mein teen waqiat Musa Alaihis Salam ke liye foran samajh mein na aaye. Aakhir mein unki wajah batayi gayi. Kahani dikhati hai ke zahiri manzar aur poori haqeeqat mein farq ho sakta hai, aur insaan ke ilm ki hadd hoti hai.
pages.english:
Musa Alaihis Salam journeyed with a servant of Allah to learn. The reasons behind events involving a boat, a boy and a wall were explained afterward.

Three incidents were not immediately understandable to Musa Alaihis Salam. Their reasons were explained at the end. The account distinguishes appearances from fuller knowledge and reminds the reader of human limits.
pages.titleEnglish: Lessons on the Journey for Knowledge

pages.title: Maut aur qurb ki dua
pages.roman:
Sahih Bukhari Musa Alaihis Salam ki wafat ke waqie ka zikr karti hai. Maut ka waqt aaya to unhon ne Allah Ta'ala se muqaddas sarzameen ke qareeb pahunchane ki dua ki. Riwayat unki qabr ko surkh retili pahari ke qareeb batati hai.

Unki kahani mein azmaishon aur zimmedariyon ke saath apne Rabb ki taraf rujoo baar-baar nazar aata hai. Sahih riwayat mein unki maut aur muqaddas zameen ke qareeb hone ki darkhwast ka zikr milta hai. Unki kahani ka markaz dawat, nijat aur Allah Ta'ala ki rehnumai rehta hai.
pages.english:
Sahih Bukhari recounts Musa Alaihis Salam’s death and his prayer to be brought near the sacred land. The report describes his grave near a red sandy hill. The sahih report mentions his death and request concerning nearness to the holy land.

His mission, rescue and Allah's guidance remain the account's centre.
pages.noteRoman: Is se aage unki qabr ki exact location ka tourist marker nahi banaya gaya.
pages.noteEnglish: It is not used here to plot an exact grave location.
pages.titleEnglish: A Prayer Near the End of Life

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran describes Musa Alaihis Salam’s birth and early life. No exact calendar date is supplied here.
books.teaser: Musa Alaihis Salam ki kahani ek bachche ki hifazat se shuru hoti hai aur Firaun ke samne Allah Ta'ala ka paigham pahunchane tak barhti hai.
books.openingRoman: Musa Alaihis Salam ki kahani ek bachche ki hifazat se shuru hoti hai aur Firaun ke samne Allah Ta'ala ka paigham pahunchane tak barhti hai. Hijrat, samandar ka rasta aur qaum ki rehnumai is safar ke aham marhale hain.
books.openingEnglish: The story of Musa Alaihis Salam begins with the protection of a child and develops into a mission before Pharaoh. Leaving Egypt, the passage through the sea and guiding his people form major stages.

books.name: Harun Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Musa Alaihis Salam ke bhai
pages.roman:
Musa Alaihis Salam ne apne bhai Harun Alaihis Salam ko madadgar banane ki dua ki. Allah Ta'ala ne unki darkhwast qubool ki aur Harun Alaihis Salam ko unki madad ke liye diya.

Musa Alaihis Salam ki dua mein bhai ko quwwat aur kaam ka saathi banane ki darkhwast thi. Harun Alaihis Salam ka kirdar isi mission se samne aata hai. Quran unki nabuwat ko Allah Ta'ala ki rahmat ka hissa kehta hai.
pages.english:
Musa Alaihis Salam asked Allah to appoint his brother Harun Alaihis Salam as a helper. Allah granted the request.

The prayer asked for a brother who would strengthen and share the task. Harun Alaihis Salam enters the account through that mission. The Quran describes his prophethood as part of Allah's mercy.
pages.titleEnglish: The Brother of Musa Alaihis Salam

pages.title: Narmi se paigham
pages.roman:
Donon bhaiyon ki zimmedari mein dawat ka ek wazeh usool tha. Musa Alaihis Salam aur Harun Alaihis Salam ko Firaun ke paas jane aur narmi se baat karne ka hukm diya gaya. Donon ne Allah Ta'ala ki rasalat ka paigham pahunchaya.

Firaun ki zyadati dono ke liye maloom thi, magar hidayat narmi ki thi. Dono ne apni baat Rabb ki taraf se pahunchayi, zaati quwwat ki numaish ke taur par nahi. Unhein tasalli di gayi ke Allah Ta'ala unke saath sunta aur dekhta hai.
pages.english:
Musa Alaihis Salam and Harun Alaihis Salam were commanded to approach Pharaoh with gentle speech and deliver Allah’s message.

They knew Pharaoh's oppression, yet the instruction was gentle speech. Their message came from Allah rather than a display of personal power. They were reassured that Allah heard and saw them.

pages.title: Qaum mein zimmedari
pages.roman:
Harun Alaihis Salam ko qaum ke darmiyan bhi zimmedari di gayi. Musa Alaihis Salam apne Rabb ki muqarrar muddat ke liye gaye to Harun Alaihis Salam ko qaum mein apni jagah rakha. Unhein islah aur fasad se bachne ki hidayat di.

Yeh zimmedari naam ki niyabat nahi thi. Musa Alaihis Salam ne qaum ki islah karne aur fasad walon ke rasta se bachne ki hidayat di. Isi darmiyan pesh aane wala waqia Harun Alaihis Salam ke liye sakht imtihan bana.
pages.english:
When Musa Alaihis Salam left for his appointed meeting, he placed Harun Alaihis Salam in charge, instructing him to maintain order and avoid corruption.

This was a real responsibility to maintain reform and avoid corruption. The events that followed became a serious trial for Harun Alaihis Salam among the people.

pages.title: Azmaish mein rokna
pages.roman:
Isi zimmedari mein bachhre ki azmaish pesh aayi. Jab kuch log bachhre ki taraf mayil hue, Harun Alaihis Salam ne unhein samjhaya ke unka Rabb Rahman hai. Qaum ne Musa Alaihis Salam ki wapsi tak apna amal chhorne se inkar kiya.

Unhon ne saaf bataya ke bachhra azmaish hai aur unka Rabb Rahman hai. Musa Alaihis Salam ki wapsi par unhon ne qaum ke bat jane ka andesha bayan kiya. Is guftagu ko dekh kar unki naseehat aur mushkil zimmedari dono samajh mein aati hain.
pages.english:
When some turned to the calf, Harun Alaihis Salam reminded them that their Lord was the Most Merciful. They refused to stop until Musa Alaihis Salam returned.

He clearly warned that the calf was a trial and that their Lord was the Most Merciful. On Musa Alaihis Salam's return, he explained his fear of division. The exchange shows both his warning and the difficulty of his responsibility.

pages.title: Allah ka salam
pages.roman:
Quran donon bhaiyon ko apni nematon ke saath yaad karta hai. Quran Musa Alaihis Salam aur Harun Alaihis Salam dono par Allah Ta'ala ki nemat, nijat aur seedhi rahnumai ka zikr karta hai. Donon par salam bheja gaya hai.

Pehle dua mein mushtarka kaam ki darkhwast thi; ab Quran dono ko nijat aur hidayat ki nemat ke saath yaad karta hai.
pages.english: The Quran recounts Allah’s favour, rescue and guidance for Musa Alaihis Salam and Harun Alaihis Salam, and sends peace upon them. The story began with a request to share the mission and ends with Allah's favour and peace upon both brothers.
pages.noteRoman: Is kahani ka ikhtitam unki qadr aur Allah Ta'ala ke salam par hota hai, na ke ghair-sabit wafat ki tafseel par.
pages.noteEnglish: Unrecorded details of death are not added to complete a biography.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Musa Alaihis Salam ne apne bhai Harun Alaihis Salam ko madadgar banane ki dua ki.
books.openingRoman: Musa Alaihis Salam ne apne bhai Harun Alaihis Salam ko madadgar banane ki dua ki. Donon ki dawat aur qaum ke darmiyan Harun Alaihis Salam ki zimmedari is kahani ka markaz hain.
books.openingEnglish: Musa Alaihis Salam asked Allah to appoint his brother Harun Alaihis Salam as a helper. Their shared mission and the responsibility of Harun Alaihis Salam among the people are central to this account.

books.name: Dhul-Kifl Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Sabr walon mein zikr
pages.roman:
Quran Ismail Alaihis Salam, Idris Alaihis Salam aur Dhul-Kifl Alaihis Salam ko sabr karne walon mein shamil karta hai.

Yeh naam ek lambi tareekhi kahani ke bajaye nek bandon ke zikr mein milta hai. Unki qaum, ilaqe aur bachpan ke bare mein in ayaat se tafseel nahi milti. Is liye unki kahani mein sabr ki wahi sifat samne rakhi gayi hai jo Quran ne bayan ki.
pages.english: The Quran names Dhul-Kifl Alaihis Salam with Ismail Alaihis Salam and Idris Alaihis Salam among the patient. His name appears in the account of righteous servants rather than a detailed biography. This account therefore centres on the patience the Quran actually attributes to him.
pages.noteRoman: In ayaat se unki paidaish, shehar ya peshe ki mazeed kahani nahi banayi gayi.
pages.noteEnglish: It does not supply a detailed biography in these passages. These verses do not provide his people, region or childhood.

pages.title: Neki aur rahmat
pages.roman:
Is sabr ke zikr ke saath neki aur rahmat ka zikr bhi hai. Allah Ta'ala ne unhein apni rahmat mein dakhil kiya aur nek logon mein shumar kiya. Surah Sad mein bhi Dhul-Kifl Alaihis Salam ka zikr achhe logon ke saath aata hai.

Sabr ka pehla zikr rahmat aur neki ki tareef se mil kar mukammal hota hai. Is chhote bayan mein bhi Allah Ta'ala ke nazdeek nek bandon ki qadr ka wazeh paigham hai.
pages.english: He is included among the righteous admitted into Allah’s mercy, and is named among the outstanding in Surah Sad. The mention of patience is completed by praise of righteousness and mercy. Even this brief account clearly records Allah's regard for His righteous servants.
pages.noteRoman: Hum unke bare mein ghair-sabit mukalme ya shehar ki kahani nahi banate.
pages.noteEnglish: Unverified conversations and locations are not supplied.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Dhul-Kifl Alaihis Salam ke bare mein Quran tafseeli waqiat nahi sunata.
books.openingRoman: Dhul-Kifl Alaihis Salam ke bare mein Quran tafseeli waqiat nahi sunata. Unka zikr sabr, neki aur Allah Ta'ala ki rahmat ke saath aata hai; isi sabit zikr tak yeh mukhtasar kahani mehdood hai.
books.openingEnglish: The Quran gives no detailed life narrative of Dhul-Kifl Alaihis Salam. This short account stays with its references to patience, righteousness and Allah’s mercy.

books.name: Dawud Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Jalut ke muqable mein
pages.roman:
Talut ke lashkar aur Jalut ki fauj ka muqabla hua. Allah Ta'ala ke izn se Dawud Alaihis Salam ne Jalut ko qatl kiya. Allah Ta'ala ne Dawud Alaihis Salam ko hukumat, hikmat aur ilm ata kiya.

Talut ke lashkar aur Jalut ke muqable ke bayan mein Dawud Alaihis Salam ka naam samne aata hai. Quran fatah ko Allah Ta'ala ke izn se jorta hai. Is ke baad unhein hukumat aur hikmat di gayi; quwwat ke saath insaf ki zimmedari bhi aayi.
pages.english:
In the battle between Talut’s force and Jalut’s army, Dawud Alaihis Salam killed Jalut by Allah’s permission. Allah granted him rule, wisdom and knowledge.

Dawud Alaihis Salam is named in the account of Talut's forces facing Jalut. Victory is attributed to Allah's permission. Kingship and wisdom followed, bringing a responsibility for justice along with power.

pages.title: Zabur ki ata
pages.roman:
Dawud Alaihis Salam par Allah Ta'ala ki ata mein wahi bhi shamil thi. Allah Ta'ala ne Dawud Alaihis Salam ko Zabur ata ki. Quran unhein wahi pane wale Anbiya mein zikr karta hai.

Zabur ki ata unki zindagi ko Allah Ta'ala ki wahi ke saath jorti hai. Quran dusre Anbiya ko di gayi wahi ke silsile mein is nemat ko yaad karta hai. Unki qadr ko sirf hukumat se naapna unki nabuwat ke is pehlu ko nazar-andaz karna hoga.
pages.english:
Allah gave Dawud Alaihis Salam the Zabur. The Quran names him among the prophets who received revelation.

The gift of the Zabur connects his life with revelation. The Quran mentions it alongside the revelation given to other prophets. His honour cannot be measured only by political rule.

pages.title: Tasbeeh aur qudrat
pages.roman:
Unki tasbeeh ke saath qudrat ka ek khaas zikr aata hai. Allah Ta'ala ne paharon aur parindon ko Dawud Alaihis Salam ke saath tasbeeh mein musakhkhar kiya. Yeh Allah Ta'ala ki ata thi.

Paharon ko subah-shaam tasbeeh mein saath laga diya gaya aur parindon ka bhi zikr aata hai. Dawud Alaihis Salam ki kahani mein quwwat ke saath Rabb ki yaad ka yeh manzar hai. Yeh khaas nemat Allah Ta'ala ki ata thi.
pages.english:
Allah subjected mountains and birds to glorify Him with Dawud Alaihis Salam. This was a gift from Allah.

The mountains joined in glorification morning and evening, and the birds are mentioned too. The account places remembrance of Allah alongside authority. This extraordinary favour was His gift.

pages.title: Zirah ka hunar
pages.roman:
Allah Ta'ala ki ata sirf hukumat tak mehdood na thi. Allah Ta'ala ne Dawud Alaihis Salam ko zirah banana sikhaya aur loha unke liye narm kiya. Unhein achhe amal ki hidayat di gayi.

Unhein zirah banana sikhaya gaya aur kaam ki durusti ka hukm diya gaya. Is hunar mein logon ki hifazat ka faida tha. Hukumat aur ibadat ke saath mehnat aur kaam ka yeh pehlu bhi un par Allah Ta'ala ki nematon mein shamil hai.
pages.english:
Allah taught Dawud Alaihis Salam the making of armour and softened iron for him, commanding righteous work.

He was taught to make armour and instructed in careful workmanship. This craft served protection. Work and practical skill stand alongside rule and worship among Allah's gifts to him.

pages.title: Insaf aur rujoo
pages.roman:
Hukumat ke saath insaf ki azmaish bhi aati hai. Dawud Alaihis Salam ke paas do fareeq faisle ke liye aaye. Muqaddama sunne ke baad Dawud Alaihis Salam ko azmaish ka ehsaas hua aur unhon ne maghfirat mangi.

Markaz insaf ke muamle mein apne Rabb ki taraf lautna hai.
pages.english:
Two disputants came before Dawud Alaihis Salam. The Quran records his test, plea for forgiveness and return to Allah, without the unestablished scandalous tales. After hearing the case, Dawud Alaihis Salam recognised a trial and sought forgiveness.

Its focus is returning to Allah in the responsibility of judgement.
pages.noteRoman: Quran unki azmaish, maghfirat ki talab aur Allah Ta'ala ki taraf rujoo ka zikr karta hai; ghair-sabit ilzami kahaniyan nahi jorta. Quran ke is bayan par ghair-sabit private kahaniyan nahi jori gayin.
pages.noteEnglish: Unverified private narratives are not added to the passage.

pages.title: Adl ka hukm
pages.roman:
Isi zimmedari ka usool Quran wazeh karta hai. Allah Ta'ala ne Dawud Alaihis Salam ko zameen mein khalifah banakar haq ke saath faisla karne aur khwahish ki pairwi se bachne ko kaha.

Hukumat ki nemat ke saath hawa-e-nafs se bachne ki tanbeeh bhi aayi. Insaf ka hukm kahani ke pehle se milne wale ilm aur quwwat ko ek zimmedari mein badalta hai. Dawud Alaihis Salam ka zikr isi adl aur jawabdehi ke paigham par mukammal hota hai.
pages.english:
Allah appointed Dawud Alaihis Salam as a vicegerent and commanded him to judge justly rather than follow personal desire.

The gift of rule came with a warning not to follow desire. The command to judge fairly turns power and knowledge into accountability. Justice gives this account its closing emphasis.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Jalut ke muqable ke zikr se Dawud Alaihis Salam ki kahani hukumat, hikmat aur ibadat ki taraf barhti hai.
books.openingRoman: Jalut ke muqable ke zikr se Dawud Alaihis Salam ki kahani hukumat, hikmat aur ibadat ki taraf barhti hai. Zabur ki ata aur insaf ki zimmedari un par Allah Ta'ala ki nematon ka hissa thin.
books.openingEnglish: From the account of Jalut, the story of Dawud Alaihis Salam turns to kingship, wisdom and worship. The gift of the Zabur and the responsibility to judge fairly were among Allah’s favours.

books.name: Sulayman Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Dawud Alaihis Salam ke baad nemat
pages.roman:
Sulayman Alaihis Salam ko Dawud Alaihis Salam ki wirasat mili. Unhon ne Allah Ta'ala ki ata ki hui nematon ka iqrar kiya. Quran unhein Allah Ta'ala ki taraf rujoo karne wala behtareen banda kehta hai.

Unhon ne aur Dawud Alaihis Salam ne Allah Ta'ala ki di hui fazilat par shukr kiya. Sulayman Alaihis Salam ko parindon ki boli ka ilm diya gaya. Aane wale waqiat mein yeh ilm unki dawat aur hukumat ki zimmedari ke saath samne aata hai.
pages.english:
Sulayman Alaihis Salam inherited from Dawud Alaihis Salam and acknowledged Allah’s gifts. The Quran praises him as an excellent servant who turned to Allah.

He and Dawud Alaihis Salam gave thanks for Allah's favour. Sulayman Alaihis Salam was taught the speech of birds. The events that follow connect this knowledge with his mission and responsibility.

pages.title: Samajh aur faisla
pages.roman:
Is nemat mein faisla karne ki samajh bhi thi. Ek kheti ke muamle mein Dawud Alaihis Salam aur Sulayman Alaihis Salam ne faisla kiya. Allah Ta'ala ne Sulayman Alaihis Salam ko us muamle ki samajh di aur dono ko hikmat aur ilm diya.

Kheti ke nuqsan ke muamle mein Allah Ta'ala ne Sulayman Alaihis Salam ko khaas samajh di, aur dono ko ilm aur hikmat ata ki. Yeh farq ek ko be-qadr karne ke liye nahi. Faisle ki durusti ko Allah Ta'ala ki di hui samajh se jora gaya hai.
pages.english:
Dawud Alaihis Salam and Sulayman Alaihis Salam judged a case involving a field. Allah gave Sulayman Alaihis Salam understanding and granted both wisdom and knowledge.

Allah gave Sulayman Alaihis Salam particular understanding in the case of damaged crops, while granting both prophets wisdom and knowledge. The account honours both and attributes sound understanding to Allah.

pages.title: Cheentiyon ki waadi
pages.roman:
Shukr ka ek manzar cheentiyon ki waadi mein samne aata hai. Sulayman Alaihis Salam ne cheenti ki baat samjhi aur apne Rabb se nematon ka shukr aur nek amal ki dua ki. Cheenti ki baat sun kar unhon ne muskurate hue shukr ki dua ki.

Lashkar ki quwwat ke darmiyan unki tawajjuh chhoti makhlooq ko nuksan se bachane aur apne Rabb ka shukr karne par gayi.
pages.english: Hearing the ant in the valley, Sulayman Alaihis Salam prayed for gratitude and righteous action. Hearing the ant's warning led him to smile and pray in gratitude. Amid the strength of an army, the account draws attention to a small creature and thankfulness.
pages.noteRoman: Illustration mein sirf waadi aur raste honge.
pages.noteEnglish: The illustration uses the valley alone.

pages.title: Saba ki khabar
pages.roman:
Phir kahani Saba se aane wali khabar ki taraf murti hai. Hudhud Saba se khabar laya ke wahan ek aurat hukumat karti hai aur log suraj ko sajda karte hain. Sulayman Alaihis Salam ne unhein Allah Ta'ala ki farmanbardari ki taraf paigham bheja.

Hudhud ki khabar ko foran faisla banane ke bajaye unhon ne uski sachchai janchne ko kaha. Phir Saba ki taraf paigham bheja gaya. Ilm aur khabar ka yeh muamla aage ek hukmaran ko Allah Ta'ala ki bandagi ki dawat se jurta hai.
pages.english:
The hoopoe brought news of a queen and people worshipping the sun in Saba. Sulayman Alaihis Salam sent a message calling them to submit to Allah.

The hoopoe's report was to be checked rather than accepted as a final verdict immediately. A message was then sent to Saba, connecting the news with an invitation to worship Allah.

pages.title: Tohfa aur paigham
pages.roman:
Is paigham ke jawab mein mashwara aur tohfe ka zikr aata hai. Malika ne mashwara kiya aur tohfa bheja. Sulayman Alaihis Salam ne Allah Ta'ala ki ata ko unke maal se behtar bataya aur apne paigham par qaim rahe.

Malika ne apne sardaron se mashwara kiya aur tohfa bhej kar jawab dekhna chaha. Sulayman Alaihis Salam ne maal ko paigham ka maqsad nahi banaya. Baat tohfe ki qeemat se barh kar Allah Ta'ala ki di hui nemat aur ita-at ki thi.
pages.english:
The queen consulted her advisers and sent a gift. Sulayman Alaihis Salam valued Allah’s gifts above their wealth and stood by his message.

The queen consulted her leaders and sent a gift. Sulayman Alaihis Salam did not treat wealth as the object of the message. His response pointed beyond the gift to Allah's favour and obedience.

pages.title: Takht aur shukr
pages.roman:
Malika ke aane se pehle uska takht Sulayman Alaihis Salam ke paas laya gaya. Sulayman Alaihis Salam ne is nemat ko shukr ya nashukri ki azmaish kaha.

Takht ko apne samne dekh kar unhon ne ise apne Rabb ka fazl kaha. Sawal yeh tha ke woh shukr karte hain ya na-shukri. Ghair-mamooli ikhtiyar ka manzar khud-pasandi par nahi, apni azmaish ko pehchanne par khatam hota hai.
pages.english:
Before the queen arrived, her throne was brought. Sulayman Alaihis Salam recognized this favour as a test of gratitude.

On seeing the throne, he called it his Lord's favour and a test of gratitude. The extraordinary event leads to acknowledgement of responsibility rather than self-congratulation.

pages.title: Malika ka iqrar
pages.roman:
Phir malika ne Allah Ta'ala ki farmanbardari ka iqrar kiya. Malika ne nishaniyan dekhin aur Sulayman Alaihis Salam ke saath Allah Ta'ala, Rabb-ul-alameen ki farmanbardari ka iqrar kiya. Quran is waqia mein uska naam nahi batata.

Pehchan aur mahal ke waqie ke baad malika ne apne upar zulm ka iqrar kiya. Usne Sulayman Alaihis Salam ke saath Rabb-ul-alamin ki farmanbardari qabool ki.
pages.english: After witnessing the signs, the queen declared submission with Sulayman Alaihis Salam to Allah, Lord of the worlds. Following the events concerning the throne and palace, the queen acknowledged her wrong and submitted with Sulayman Alaihis Salam to the Lord of all worlds.
pages.noteRoman: Kahani ka markaz shadi ki ghair-sabit tafseel nahi, yeh iqrar hai.
pages.noteEnglish: The Quran does not name her. Unrecorded marriage details are not added.

pages.title: Ikhtiyar bhi Allah ki ata
pages.roman:
Quran unke ikhtiyar aur wafat se juri ek aur seekh bhi deta hai. Allah Ta'ala ne hawa aur kaam karne walon ko Sulayman Alaihis Salam ke liye musakhkhar kiya. Unki wafat ka waqia yeh bhi wazeh karta hai ke jinn ghaib nahi jaante.

Hawa aur dusre kaamon par diya gaya ikhtiyar bhi Allah Ta'ala ki ata tha. Wafat ke waqie se jinnon ke ilm ki hadd wazeh hui. Unki kahani aakhir tak isi farq ko barqarar rakhti hai: makhlooq ka ikhtiyar mehdood hai aur Rabb ka ilm kaamil.
pages.english:
Allah subjected the wind and workers to Sulayman Alaihis Salam. The account of his death also makes clear that the jinn did not know the unseen.

His authority over the wind and other tasks was Allah's gift. The account of his death exposed the limits of the jinn's knowledge. Created power remains limited, while Allah's knowledge is complete.
pages.titleEnglish: Authority Is a Gift from Allah

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Sulayman Alaihis Salam ko ilm aur ikhtiyar ki khaas nematein milin.
books.openingRoman: Sulayman Alaihis Salam ko ilm aur ikhtiyar ki khaas nematein milin. Cheentiyon ki waadi, Saba ka paigham aur malika ki amad ke waqiat mein woh in nematon ko shukr ki azmaish ke taur par pehchante hain.
books.openingEnglish: Sulayman Alaihis Salam received special gifts of knowledge and authority. The valley of the ants, the message to Saba and the queen’s arrival reveal his recognition of these gifts as a test of gratitude.

books.name: Ilyas Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Rasool ki dawat
pages.roman:
Quran Ilyas Alaihis Salam ko rasoolon mein se batata hai. Unhon ne apni qaum se Allah Ta'ala ka taqwa ikhtiyar karne ko kaha.

Quran unhein rasoolon mein shamil karke qaum se ki gayi guftagu sunata hai. Unka paigham logon ke apne Rabb se taalluq ko durust karna tha. Paidaish ke ghair-maloom waqiat se aaghaz karne ke bajaye kahani isi sabit dawat se shuru hoti hai.
pages.english:
The Quran names Ilyas Alaihis Salam among the messengers. He called his people to be mindful of Allah. The Quran names him among the messengers and records his address to his people.

His mission called them back to their Lord.
pages.noteEnglish: The account begins with this established message rather than an unrecorded childhood.

pages.title: Baal ki ibadat se rokna
pages.roman:
Unki dawat mein qaumi ibadat par wazeh sawal tha. Ilyas Alaihis Salam ne qaum ko Baal ko pukarne aur behtareen paida karne wale Allah Ta'ala ko chhorne par toka. Unhon ne Allah Ta'ala ko apna aur pehle logon ka Rabb bataya.

Unhon ne qaum ko yaad dilaya ke Allah Ta'ala unka bhi Rabb hai aur unke pehle baap-dada ka bhi. But ki ibadat ko purani riwayat bana lena uski sachchai ki daleel nahi tha. Dawat ka markaz isi ek Rabb ki pehchan tha.
pages.english:
Ilyas Alaihis Salam challenged the people for calling upon Baal and abandoning Allah, the best of creators and Lord of their ancestors.

He reminded them that Allah was their Lord and the Lord of their forefathers. The age of an inherited practice did not establish its truth. Worship of the One Lord remained central to his call.

pages.title: Mukhlis bandon ka rasta
pages.roman:
Is dawat ke samne qaum ka rawaiya bhi bayan hua hai. Qaum ne jhutlaya, magar Allah Ta'ala ke mukhlis bande alag rahe. Quran Ilyas Alaihis Salam ke liye baad walon mein achha zikr aur salam bayan karta hai.

Qaum ke jhutlane ke saath mukhlis bandon ka zikr alag aata hai. Phir Allah Ta'ala ke salam aur achhe zikr se is bayan ka ikhtitam hota hai. Ilyas Alaihis Salam ki zindagi ki har anjaani kadi bharne ke bajaye Quran ki is tareef ko barqarar rakha gaya hai.
pages.english: The people rejected him, except Allah’s sincere servants. The Quran preserves honourable remembrance and peace for Ilyas Alaihis Salam. The passage distinguishes sincere servants from those who rejected the message, then closes with peace and honourable remembrance.
pages.noteEnglish: This retelling preserves that ending instead of inventing missing stages of his life.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Ilyas Alaihis Salam ne apni qaum ko Baal ko pukarne ke bajaye Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat ki taraf bulaya.
books.openingRoman: Ilyas Alaihis Salam ne apni qaum ko Baal ko pukarne ke bajaye Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat ki taraf bulaya. Quran unki dawat aur un par salam ka zikr mehfooz rakhta hai.
books.openingEnglish: Ilyas Alaihis Salam called his people to worship Allah rather than invoke Baal. The Quran preserves his call and a greeting of peace upon him.

books.name: Al-Yasa Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Hidayat pane walon mein
pages.roman:
Al-Yasa Alaihis Salam ka naam Quran mein Ismail Alaihis Salam, Yunus Alaihis Salam aur Lut Alaihis Salam ke saath aata hai. Allah Ta'ala ne unhein fazilat ata ki. Unki zindagi ki mazeed tafseel in ayaat mein nahi milti.

Naam ka yeh zikr apne aap mein Quran ki di hui izzat hai. Unke saath dusre rehnuma Anbiya ka zikr aata hai, lekin yahan unke ghar, qaum ya kisi khaas safar ki tafseel nahi di gayi. Hum is khamoshi ko andazon se nahi bharte.
pages.english: Al-Yasa Alaihis Salam is named with Ismail Alaihis Salam, Yunus Alaihis Salam and Lut Alaihis Salam among those whom Allah favoured. Being named in the Quran is itself an honour. He appears alongside other guided prophets, but the passage does not describe his household, people or a particular journey.
pages.noteEnglish: These verses do not provide a detailed life narrative. This retelling does not fill that silence with guesses.

pages.title: Nek logon mein zikr
pages.roman:
Quran ki ek aur jagah unka zikr neki ke saath hai. Surah Sad mein Ismail Alaihis Salam, Al-Yasa Alaihis Salam aur Dhul-Kifl Alaihis Salam ka zikr hai aur sab ko achhe logon mein bataya gaya hai. Surah Sad ka zikr pehle taaruf ko neki ki tareef se jorta hai.

Lambi kahani ke baghair bhi unka naam yaad rakhna aur Quran ki di hui qadr samajhna mumkin hai.
pages.english:
Surah Sad names Ismail Alaihis Salam, Al-Yasa Alaihis Salam and Dhul-Kifl Alaihis Salam among the outstanding. This account stays within that established description. Surah Sad adds praise among the outstanding.

The brief conclusion respects the limits of the source.
pages.noteRoman: Hum isi sabit zikr tak mehdood rehte hain. Unki kahani ka yeh mukhtasar ikhtitam source ki had ko barqarar rakhta hai.
pages.noteEnglish: His name and the honour given in the Quran can be understood without constructing a longer, unverified biography.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Al-Yasa Alaihis Salam ke tafseeli waqiat Quran mein bayan nahi hue.
books.openingRoman: Al-Yasa Alaihis Salam ke tafseeli waqiat Quran mein bayan nahi hue. Unka naam hidayat, fazilat aur neki ke zikr mein aata hai. Yahan isi pehchan ko parhein.
books.openingEnglish: The Quran does not narrate detailed events from the life of Al-Yasa Alaihis Salam. It records his name among those granted guidance, distinction and righteousness.

books.name: Yunus Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Paigham aur rawangi
pages.roman:
Yunus Alaihis Salam Allah Ta'ala ke rasoolon mein se the. Quran unke rawana hone aur bhari hui kashti tak pahunchne ka zikr karta hai. Unki kahani ab samandar ki ek badi azmaish ki taraf barhti hai.

Yunus Alaihis Salam ki rawangi ka waqia unki rasalat ke zikr ke saath aata hai. Quran unke gusse mein jane ka bhi zikr karta hai. Aage jo azmaish aati hai us mein apni ghalati ka iqrar aur Rabb ki taraf wapsi kahani ka markaz bante hain.
pages.english:
Yunus Alaihis Salam was among the messengers. The Quran describes his departure and boarding a laden ship, without supplying a detailed date or itinerary.

His departure is mentioned alongside his messengership and anger. The trial that follows centres on acknowledgement of wrong and a return to Allah.

pages.title: Samandar ki azmaish
pages.roman:
Kashti mein qura dala gaya aur Yunus Alaihis Salam usmein aa gaye. Phir machhli ne unhein nigal liya. Samandar ka yeh waqia unki kahani ka woh hissa hai jahan aage unki dua ka zikr aata hai.

Bhari hui kashti mein qur'a dala gaya aur Yunus Alaihis Salam us mein aaye. Phir machhli ne unhein nigal liya. Quran ke is manzar ko ek muayyan machhli ki qism, size ya kalpanik samandari safar ki tafseel se nahi bhara gaya.
pages.english:
Lots were drawn aboard the ship, and Yunus Alaihis Salam was among those selected. A fish swallowed him.

Lots were drawn on the laden ship, and Yunus Alaihis Salam was among those selected. A fish swallowed him. The passage is not expanded with guesses about species, size or an imagined voyage.

pages.title: Andheron mein dua
pages.roman:
Samandar ki azmaish aur machhli ke nigal lene ke baad Quran Yunus Alaihis Salam ki dua ka zikr karta hai. Andheron mein unhon ne Allah Ta'ala ko pukara, uski pakizgi bayan ki aur apni ghalati ka iqrar kiya.

Allah Ta'ala ne unki pukar qubool ki aur unhein gham se nijat di. Yeh dua usi kahani ka hissa hai jo kashti se shuru hokar aage khule kinare tak pahunchti hai.

Unki pukar mein Allah Ta'ala ki wahdaniyat aur paaki ka iqrar tha, phir apne zulm ka iqrar. Andheron ka manzar na-umeedi par khatam nahi hota. Allah Ta'ala ne unki dua qubool ki aur gham se nijat di.
pages.english:
After the trial at sea and the fish swallowing him, the Quran describes the supplication of Yunus Alaihis Salam. In darkness he called upon Allah, declared His perfection and acknowledged his wrongdoing.

Allah answered him and delivered him from distress. The same account that began with the ship continues towards his arrival on the open shore.

His prayer affirmed Allah's oneness and perfection, then acknowledged his own wrong. The darkness did not end in despair. Allah answered him and delivered him from distress.

pages.title: Kinara aur hifazat
pages.roman:
Yunus Alaihis Salam kamzori ki halat mein khule kinare par dale gaye. Allah Ta'ala ne un par beldar paudha ugaya. Sakht azmaish ke baad unki hifazat aur bahali bhi Allah Ta'ala ki rahmat se hui.

Kamzori ki halat mein kinare par dale jane ke baad unke liye bel-dar pauda ugaya gaya. Yeh manzar pehle andheron se bahar rehmat aur dekhbhal ki taraf le jata hai. Riwayat se bahar ki sehat-yabi ki muddat yahan tay nahi ki gayi.
pages.english:
Yunus Alaihis Salam was cast onto the open shore in a weakened state. Allah caused a gourd plant to grow over him.

He was cast onto the shore in weakness, and a spreading plant was caused to grow over him. The scene moves from darkness to care and mercy without inventing a recovery timetable.

pages.title: Qaum ka iman
pages.roman:
Yunus Alaihis Salam ki qaum ka waqia bhi umeed ka paigham rakhta hai. Woh iman le aaye to Allah Ta'ala ne unse ruswai ka azab hata diya.

Unhein ek muddat tak fayda uthane diya gaya. Yunus Alaihis Salam ki kahani mein dua ki qubooliyat ke saath qaum ke iman ka zikr bhi hai.

Quran unki qaum ke iman lane aur azab door hone ka zikr karta hai. Unhein ek muddat tak zindagi ka faida diya gaya. Yunus Alaihis Salam ki kahani mein ek bande ki dua aur ek qaum ki wapsi, dono rahmat ki taraf ishara karte hain.
pages.english:
When the people of Yunus Alaihis Salam believed, Allah removed the punishment of disgrace and allowed them enjoyment for a time.

The Quran records his people's belief and the removal of punishment. They were allowed enjoyment for a time. Both his prayer and their return towards belief point to mercy.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Kashti se samandar ki azmaish tak, phir andheron mein ek dua.
books.openingRoman: Kashti se samandar ki azmaish tak, phir andheron mein ek dua. Yunus Alaihis Salam ki kahani mein apne Rabb ko pukarne aur Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se nijat milne ka zikr hai.
books.openingEnglish: From a ship to a trial at sea, then a supplication in darkness: the story of Yunus Alaihis Salam tells of calling upon Allah and being delivered by Him.

books.name: Zakariya Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Paidaish ki tareekh aur bachpan ki tafseel is book ke Quran/sahih hadees sources mein nahi milti. Kahani pehle sabit zikr se shuru hoti hai.

pages.title: Maryam ki kifalat
pages.roman:
Zakariya Alaihis Salam ko Maryam ki dekhbhal mili. Jab woh unke paas ibadat ki jagah jate, unke paas rizq pate. Maryam ne bataya ke yeh Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se hai.

Jab woh Maryam ke paas ibadat ki jagah aate to rizq pate. Poochhne par Maryam ne ise Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se kaha. Isi manzar se Zakariya Alaihis Salam ki apne Rabb ke samne nek aulaad ki dua ka taalluq Quran wazeh karta hai.
pages.english:
Zakariya Alaihis Salam was entrusted with Maryam’s care. He found provision with her in the sanctuary, and she said it was from Allah.

On visiting Maryam in her place of worship, he found provision and asked about it. She attributed it to Allah. The Quran connects this scene with his prayer for righteous offspring.

pages.title: Chhupi hui dua
pages.roman:
Maryam ke paas Allah Ta'ala ka ata kiya hua rizq dekhne ke waqie mein Zakariya Alaihis Salam ki dua ka bhi zikr aata hai. Unhon ne apne Rabb se nek aulaad mangi.

Surah Maryam unki chupke se ki gayi pukar bayan karti hai. Barhape aur apni biwi ke be-aulad hone ke bawajood woh Allah Ta'ala ki ata ke umeedwar the. Unki pukar ka jawab aage Yahya Alaihis Salam ki khushkhabri mein aata hai.

Unhon ne barhape aur kamzori ka zikr kiya, magar pehli duaein bekaar hone ka shikwa nahi kiya. Pukar narmi aur posheedgi se thi. Woh apne baad nek rehnumai ki dua kar rahe the, sirf zaati naam barqarar rehne ka dawa nahi.
pages.english:
The account of Maryam receiving provision from Allah also mentions the supplication of Zakariya Alaihis Salam for righteous offspring.

Surah Maryam describes his quiet call to his Lord. Despite his old age and his wife’s barrenness, he sought Allah’s gift. The answer appears in the good news of Yahya Alaihis Salam.

He mentioned age and weakness without abandoning hope. His prayer was quiet and personal, seeking righteous continuity after him. The account centres on need before Allah rather than a claim of entitlement.

pages.title: Yahya Alaihis Salam ki khushkhabri
pages.roman:
Phir is dua ki khushkhabri aayi. Allah Ta'ala ne Yahya Alaihis Salam ki khushkhabri di. Namaz ki halat mein farishton ne unhein ek nek Nabi bete ki basharat sunayi.

Yahya Alaihis Salam ke naam ke saath basharat aayi. Zakariya Alaihis Salam ne apne barhape aur zawja ki halat ke hawale se poochha ke yeh kaise hoga. Jawab mein unki apni pehli takhleeq yaad dilayi gayi: Allah Ta'ala ke liye yeh aasaan hai.
pages.english:
Allah announced Yahya Alaihis Salam. While Zakariya Alaihis Salam stood in prayer, angels brought news of a righteous son who would be a prophet.

Good news came with the name Yahya Alaihis Salam. In response to his question about age and his wife's condition, he was reminded of his own creation. The matter was easy for Allah.
pages.titleEnglish: The Good News of Yahya Alaihis Salam

pages.title: Nishani aur tasbeeh
pages.roman:
Is khushkhabri par Zakariya Alaihis Salam ne apne Rabb se ek nishani mangi.

Unhein kuch muddat logon se baat na kar pane ki nishani di gayi, jabke woh tandurust the. Unhon ne logon ko subah-shaam tasbeeh ka ishara kiya.

Nishani yeh thi ke tandurust hote hue logon se baat na kar saken. Woh ibadat ki jagah se nikle aur subah-shaam tasbeeh ki taraf ishara kiya. Dua ka jawab unhein Rabb ki yaad se door nahi, aur zyada qareeb le gaya.
pages.english:
Zakariya Alaihis Salam was given a sign: for a period he could not speak to people despite being sound. He signalled them to glorify Allah morning and evening.

The sign concerned being unable to speak to people while otherwise sound. He signalled them to glorify Allah morning and evening. The answer to prayer remained connected with remembrance and worship.

pages.title: Dua ki qubooliyat
pages.roman:
Quran is dua ki qubooliyat ko bhi yaad dilata hai. Allah Ta'ala ne Zakariya Alaihis Salam ki dua qubool karke Yahya Alaihis Salam ata kiye aur unki biwi ko durust kar diya. Quran unke nek kaamon, umeed, khauf aur khushu ka zikr karta hai.

Allah Ta'ala ne unki zawja ki halat durust ki aur Yahya Alaihis Salam ata kiye. Quran is gharane ko neki mein jaldi karne, umeed aur khauf ke saath dua karne aur aajizi rakhne walon ke taur par yaad karta hai.
pages.english:
Allah answered Zakariya Alaihis Salam, granted Yahya Alaihis Salam and restored his wife’s ability to bear a child. The family is praised for goodness and humble devotion.

Allah restored his wife's condition and granted Yahya Alaihis Salam. The Quran remembers the household for hastening to good, praying in hope and fear, and remaining humble.

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran and sahih reports cited in this book do not provide detailed birth or childhood information. The account begins with the earliest established material presented here.
books.teaser: Maryam ki kifalat ke waqie ke saath Zakariya Alaihis Salam ki dua ki kahani bhi aati hai.
books.openingRoman: Maryam ki kifalat ke waqie ke saath Zakariya Alaihis Salam ki dua ki kahani bhi aati hai. Barhape mein ki gayi pukar ka jawab Yahya Alaihis Salam ki khushkhabri se mila.
books.openingEnglish: Alongside his care for Maryam, the Quran tells of the supplication of Zakariya Alaihis Salam. His call in old age was answered with the good news of Yahya Alaihis Salam.

books.name: Yahya Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Yahya Alaihis Salam ki paidaish ki khushkhabri Quran mein naam ke saath di gayi. Exact tareekh aur shehar yahan muqarrar nahi kiye gaye.

pages.title: Naam ke saath basharat
pages.roman:
Zakariya Alaihis Salam ko Yahya Alaihis Salam naam ke bete ki khushkhabri mili. Yeh unki dua ki qubooliyat thi aur Allah Ta'ala ki qudrat ki nishani.

Unki kahani walid ki chhupi dua ke jawab se jurti hai. Naam ka pehle se bataya jana basharat ka khaas hissa tha. Yeh aaghaz unki paidaish ki tamam tareekhi tafseel nahi deta, lekin Allah Ta'ala ki rehmat aur dua ki qubooliyat ko saaf karta hai.
pages.english: Zakariya Alaihis Salam was given glad tidings of a son named Yahya Alaihis Salam, an answer to his prayer and a sign of Allah’s power. His story is connected with the answer to his father's quiet prayer. The naming forms part of the good news.
pages.noteEnglish: It does not supply every historical detail of birth, but clearly records mercy and answered prayer.

pages.title: Bachpan mein hikmat
pages.roman:
