Yahya Alaihis Salam ko bachpan hi mein Allah Ta'ala ki khaas ata mili. Yahya Alaihis Salam ko kitab mazbooti se thamne ka hukm diya gaya. Allah Ta'ala ne unhein bachpan mein hikmat aur apni taraf se narmi aur pakizgi ata ki.

Unhein kitab ko mazbooti se pakarne ka hukm diya gaya. Bachpan mein hikmat ke saath rahm-dili aur paakizgi ka zikr bhi aata hai. Unki qadr sirf umr se nahi, Allah Ta'ala ki ata aur nek kirdar se bayan hoti hai.
pages.english:
Yahya Alaihis Salam was commanded to hold firmly to the Scripture. Allah granted him wisdom as a child, tenderness and purity.

He was instructed to hold firmly to the Scripture. Wisdom in childhood is mentioned alongside compassion and purity. His honour is described through Allah's gift and righteous character rather than age alone.

pages.title: Walidain ke saath neki
pages.roman:
Unki pehchan mein ghar walon ke saath neki bhi thi. Quran Yahya Alaihis Salam ko parhezgar aur apne walidain ke saath nek batata hai. Woh sarkash aur nafarman nahi the.

Walidain ke saath husn-e-sulook unki doosri sifaton se alag nahi. Woh sar-kash aur nafarmaan nahi the.
pages.english:
The Quran describes Yahya Alaihis Salam as devout and dutiful to his parents, neither arrogant nor disobedient.

Kindness to parents belongs alongside his other qualities. He was not arrogant or disobedient. Knowledge, reverence and good conduct within the family appear together in this brief description.
pages.noteRoman: Quran ki is chhoti si tasveer mein ilm, taqwa aur ghar ke rishton mein neki saath nazar aati hai.

pages.title: Paidaish aur anjaam par salam
pages.roman:
Quran unhein salam ke saath bhi yaad karta hai. Quran Yahya Alaihis Salam ke paida hone, wafat aur dobara uthaye jane ke din salam ka zikr karta hai. Quran unki paidaish, maut aur dobara uthaye jane ke din salam ka zikr karta hai.

Unki wafat ka tafseeli waqia in ayaat mein nahi sunaya gaya.
pages.english:
The Quran speaks of peace upon Yahya Alaihis Salam at birth, death and resurrection. Unestablished details about how he died are not added. The Quran mentions peace at his birth, death and resurrection.

It does not narrate the details of his death in these verses.
pages.noteRoman: Unki wafat ki ghair-sabit tafseeli kahani yahan shamil nahi. Is liye kahani ko ghair-sabit tashaddud ki tafseel ke bajaye isi salam par mukammal kiya gaya hai.
pages.noteEnglish: This account therefore ends with that peace rather than adding an unverified violent narrative.

books.birthNoteEnglish: Yahya Alaihis Salam’s birth is announced by name in the Quran; no exact date or city is asserted here.
books.teaser: Yahya Alaihis Salam ka naam unki paidaish ki khushkhabri mein hi diya gaya.
books.openingRoman: Yahya Alaihis Salam ka naam unki paidaish ki khushkhabri mein hi diya gaya. Quran unke bachpan ki hikmat, pakizgi aur walidain ke saath neki ki pehchan karata hai.
books.openingEnglish: Yahya Alaihis Salam was named in the announcement of his birth. The Quran describes wisdom in childhood, purity and kindness to his parents.

books.name: Isa Alaihis Salam
books.birthNote: Isa Alaihis Salam ibn Maryam ki ghair-mamooli paidaish Quran mein tafseel se bayan hai. Exact saal ya calendar date yahan claim nahi ki gayi.

pages.title: Maryam ko khushkhabri
pages.roman:
Farishton ne Maryam ko Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se Isa Alaihis Salam ibn Maryam ki khushkhabri di. Woh hairan huin ke unhein kisi mard ne chhua nahi; Allah Ta'ala jo chahta hai paida karta hai.

Farishte ne Maryam ko Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se ek kalime ki basharat di. Maryam ne poochha ke unhein aulaad kaise hogi jab kisi mard ne unhein chhua nahi. Jawab Allah Ta'ala ki qudrat ka tha: woh jo chahta hai paida karta hai.
pages.english:
Maryam received glad tidings of Isa Alaihis Salam ibn Maryam. She asked how she could have a child without a man touching her; Allah creates what He wills.

Maryam received good news of a word from Allah. She asked how she could have a child when no man had touched her. The answer concerned Allah's power to create what He wills.

pages.title: Alag jagah aur paidaish
pages.roman:
Is basharat ke baad Quran paidaish ka waqia bayan karta hai. Maryam alag jagah gayin. Dard-e-zah unhein khajoor ke tane tak le aaya.

Unhein tasalli, pani aur khajoor ki taraf rehnumai mili. Paidaish ke dard aur tanhai ke darmiyan tasalli aur rizq ki hidayat mili. Khajoor ke tanay ko hilane aur pani se faida uthane ka zikr aata hai.
pages.english: Maryam withdrew to a distant place. Labour brought her to a palm trunk, where she received reassurance and provision. Amid the pain and isolation of childbirth, she received reassurance and instructions concerning dates and water.
pages.noteRoman: Quran is jagah ka aaj ka exact tourist address nahi deta.
pages.noteEnglish: The account does not turn the place into an exact modern tourist location.

pages.title: God mein bachche ka paigham
pages.roman:
Maryam apne bachche ko lekar apni qaum ke paas aayin. Logon ne unse sawal kiye to unhon ne bachche ki taraf ishara kiya. Log hairan the ke god ke bachche se kaise baat karein.

Isa Alaihis Salam ne apne aap ko Allah Ta'ala ka banda bataya aur kitab aur nabuwat ki ata ka zikr kiya. Unki paidaish ke waqie ke saath hi unke paigham ki buniyad wazeh hoti hai: bandagi Allah Ta'ala ki hai.

Qaum ke sawal par Maryam ne bachche ki taraf ishara kiya. Isa Alaihis Salam ne Allah Ta'ala ka banda hone aur kitab aur nabuwat ki ata ka zikr kiya. Unka paigham ibadat, namaz, zakat aur walida ke saath neki se jura tha.
pages.english:
Maryam brought her child to her people. When they questioned her, she pointed to him. They wondered how they could speak to a child in the cradle.

Isa Alaihis Salam declared himself Allah’s servant and spoke of the gift of scripture and prophethood. The account of his birth thus also makes clear the foundation of his message: servitude to Allah.

In response to the people's questions, Maryam pointed to the child. Isa Alaihis Salam declared himself Allah's servant and spoke of Scripture, prophethood, worship and kindness to his mother.

pages.title: Kitab aur hikmat
pages.roman:
Isa Alaihis Salam ki zindagi ka paigham ilm aur rasalat se jura tha. Allah Ta'ala ne Isa Alaihis Salam ko kitab, hikmat, Taurat aur Injil sikhayi. Woh Bani Israil ki taraf rasool banaye gaye.

Kitab aur hikmat ki taleem ke saath Tawrat aur Injil ka zikr milta hai. Unki rasalat Bani Israil ki taraf thi. Kahani bachpan ki nishani se aage ab paigham aur rehnumai ki zimmedari ki taraf barhti hai.
pages.english:
Allah taught Isa Alaihis Salam Scripture, wisdom, the Torah and the Gospel, and sent him as a messenger to the Children of Israel.

The teaching of Scripture and wisdom includes mention of the Torah and Gospel. His mission was to Bani Israil. The account now moves from the sign in childhood towards the responsibility of conveying guidance.

pages.title: Allah ke izn se nishaniyan
pages.roman:
Unki rasalat ke saath Allah Ta'ala ki nishaniyan bhi thin. Isa Alaihis Salam ko Allah Ta'ala ke izn se nishaniyan di gayin: bemaron ko shifa aur murdon ko zinda karna bhi unmein tha. Quran har nishani ko Allah Ta'ala ke izn se jorta hai.

Andhe aur kodh ke marizon ko shifa aur murdon ko zinda karne ka zikr har martaba Allah Ta'ala ke izn se jura hai. Yeh nisbat bunyadi hai: nishani Nabi ke zariye zahir hui, qudrat ka asal malik Allah Ta'ala hai.
pages.english:
Isa Alaihis Salam was granted signs by Allah’s permission, including healing the sick and raising the dead. The Quran repeatedly stresses Allah’s permission.

Healing and the raising of the dead are repeatedly connected with Allah's permission. That qualification is essential: the signs appeared through the prophet, while power belongs to Allah.

pages.title: Ek Allah ki ibadat
pages.roman:
In nishaniyon ke darmiyan dawat ek Allah Ta'ala hi ki taraf thi. Isa Alaihis Salam ne apne Rabb aur logon ke Rabb, Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat ki dawat di. Unhon ne apne paigham ko seedha rasta bataya.

Nishaniyon ka maqsad unki zaati ibadat nahi tha. Isa Alaihis Salam ne Allah Ta'ala ko apna aur qaum ka Rabb kaha aur usi ki ibadat ka hukm diya. Pehle waqiat ki hairat ab paigham-e-tawheed ki taraf le jati hai.
pages.english:
Isa Alaihis Salam called people to worship Allah, his Lord and their Lord, describing this as the straight path.

The signs were not an invitation to worship him. Isa Alaihis Salam called Allah his Lord and their Lord and instructed them to worship Him. The extraordinary events lead towards the message of oneness.

pages.title: Hawariyon ki madad
pages.roman:
Is dawat mein hawariyon ka jawab bhi samne aaya. Isa Alaihis Salam ne Allah Ta'ala ke raste mein madadgar pooche to hawariyon ne iman aur farmanbardari ka iqrar kiya. Unhon ne Allah Ta'ala se gawahon mein likhe jane ki dua ki.

Jab inkar ka ehsaas hua to unhon ne Allah Ta'ala ke rasta mein madadgaron ko pukara. Hawariyon ne iman aur madad ka iqrar kiya. Is jawab mein dawat ke saath khare hone aur Allah Ta'ala ke samne apni gawahi ka pehlu samne aata hai.
pages.english:
When Isa Alaihis Salam sought helpers in Allah’s cause, the disciples affirmed faith and submission, asking Allah to count them among the witnesses.

When he perceived rejection, he asked who would support Allah's cause. The disciples affirmed belief and support. Their response connects commitment to the mission with witness before Allah.

pages.title: Aasmani dastarkhwan ki darkhwast
pages.roman:
Hawariyon se jura ek aur waqia dastarkhwan ki darkhwast ka hai. Hawariyon ne aasman se dastarkhwan mangne ki darkhwast ki.

Isa Alaihis Salam ne Allah Ta'ala se rizq aur nishani ki dua ki. Allah Ta'ala ne utarne ke baad inkar par sakht tanbeeh ki.

Darkhwast mein dil ke itminan aur gawahi ka zikr hua. Isa Alaihis Salam ne Rabb se rizq aur nishani ki dua ki. Jawab ke saath nishani ke baad inkar ki sakht tanbeeh bhi aayi; mo'jize ko be-zimmedar tamasha nahi banaya gaya.
pages.english:
The disciples asked for a table from heaven. Isa Alaihis Salam prayed for provision and a sign, and Allah warned against disbelief after it.

The request concerned reassurance and testimony. Isa Alaihis Salam prayed for provision and a sign. The response included a severe warning against rejection afterwards; a sign also brought accountability.
pages.titleEnglish: The Request for a Table from Heaven

pages.title: Hifazat aur Allah ki taraf uthaya jana
pages.roman:
Quran Isa Alaihis Salam ke bare mein dushmanon ke dawe ki bhi tardeed karta hai. Quran ke mutabiq dushmanon ne Isa Alaihis Salam ko na qatl kiya na sooli di, balki Allah Ta'ala ne unhein apni taraf utha liya. Quran saaf karta hai ke unhein na qatl kiya gaya aur na saleeb par mara gaya.

Allah Ta'ala ne unhein apni taraf uthaya.
pages.english: The Quran states that his enemies neither killed nor crucified Isa Alaihis Salam; Allah raised him to Himself. No invented visual of this event is used. The Quran states that they did not kill or crucify him and that Allah raised him.
pages.noteRoman: Hum is se aage man-gharat tasveer ya tafseel nahi jorte. Kahani ka yeh hissa wahin rukta hai jahan source bayan karta hai; ghair-sabit chhupi safar ki kahani nahi jorta.
pages.noteEnglish: This account stops where the passage does, without constructing an unverified hidden journey.
pages.titleEnglish: Protection and Being Raised to Allah

pages.title: Aane wale rasool ki basharat
pages.roman:
Unke paigham mein aane wale rasool ki basharat bhi thi. Isa Alaihis Salam ne apne baad Ahmad naam ke rasool ki khushkhabri di. Quran unke paigham ko pehle ki Taurat ki tasdeeq aur Allah Ta'ala ki taraf dawat se jorta hai.

Unhon ne apne se pehle ki Tawrat ki tasdeeq aur apne baad Ahmad naam ke Rasool ki basharat di. Is aakhri hisse mein Anbiya ka paigham alag-alag dawon ke bajaye ek Rabb ki hidayat ke silsile mein samne aata hai.
pages.english:
Isa Alaihis Salam confirmed the Torah before him and announced a messenger to come after him named Ahmad.

He affirmed the Torah before him and gave good news of a messenger after him named Ahmad. This closing connects the prophets within a continuing message of guidance from the One Lord.
pages.titleEnglish: Good News of a Messenger to Come

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran describes Isa Alaihis Salam’s extraordinary birth. No exact calendar date is asserted here.
books.teaser: Maryam ko di gayi khushkhabri se Isa Alaihis Salam ki ghair-mamooli paidaish ka zikr shuru hota hai.
books.openingRoman: Maryam ko di gayi khushkhabri se Isa Alaihis Salam ki ghair-mamooli paidaish ka zikr shuru hota hai. Unki rasalat aur nishaniyon ke saath Quran baar-baar Allah Ta'ala ke izn aur ek Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat ko wazeh karta hai.
books.openingEnglish: The announcement to Maryam introduces the extraordinary birth of Isa Alaihis Salam. In describing his mission and signs, the Quran repeatedly makes clear Allah’s permission and the call to worship Allah alone.

books.name: Muhammad ﷺ
books.birthNote: Is book mein exact birth date claim nahi ki gayi. Quran aapke yateem hone aur Allah Ta'ala ki hifazat ka zikr karta hai; sahih hadees se wahi aur zindagi ke waqiat aage aate hain.

pages.title: Paidaish ka din
pages.roman:
Rasool Allah Ta'ala ﷺ ne Monday ke roze ke bare mein bataya ke isi din aap paida hue aur isi din wahi nazil hui. Yeh din sahih hadees se sabit hai; exact calendar date yahan claim nahi ki gayi. Sahih Muslim ki riwayat mein Somwar ke roze ke jawab mein paidaish ke din aur wahi ka zikr aata hai.

Aage kahani aap ﷺ ki parwarish aur wahi ki taraf barhti hai.
pages.english:
Asked about fasting on Monday, the Messenger explained that he was born on that day and revelation came on it. No exact calendar birth date is asserted here.

The sahih report connects Monday with his birth and revelation. It establishes the day mentioned in the report, not every disputed calendar date. The account then moves towards care in his early life and revelation.
pages.noteRoman: Is source se Somwar ka din maloom hota hai, har tareekhi tareekh ka faisla nahi.

pages.title: Shuruati zindagi aur Allah ki hifazat
pages.roman:
Ibtidai zindagi ki Allah Ta'ala ki nemat Quran bhi yaad dilata hai. Quran yaad dilata hai ke Allah Ta'ala ne aapko yateem paya aur panah di.

Surah Ad-Duha mein Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se panah aur rehnumai ki nematein yaad dilayi gayin. Is yaad ke saath yateem aur mangne wale ke saath rawaiye ki hidayat bhi surah mein aati hai. Shuruati zindagi ka zikr Allah Ta'ala ki meherbani ki taraf mutawajjih karta hai.
pages.english:
The Quran recalls that Allah found you an orphan and gave shelter. Surah Ad-Duha recalls Allah's shelter and guidance. The remembrance of these favours is connected in the surah with care towards others.

The opening account directs attention to Allah's kindness.
pages.noteRoman: Aapke bachpan ki ghair-sabit moajizati kahaniyan ya muqarrar birth date yahan shamil nahi ki gayi.
pages.noteEnglish: This account does not invent a birth date or unestablished childhood miracles.

pages.title: Hira mein pehli wahi
pages.roman:
Phir zindagi ka woh marhala aaya jab wahi shuru hui. Sahih Bukhari ke mutabiq aap par wahi chalis saal ki umar mein shuru hui.

Rasool Allah Ta'ala ﷺ Hira mein ibadat ke liye tanhai ikhtiyar karte the. Wahi ke farishte aaye aur parhne ka hukm diya. Surah Al-Alaq ki ibtidai ayaat nazil huin.

Ghaar-e-Hira mein farishte ka paigham aaya to wahi ka silsila shuru hua. Riwayat aap ﷺ ki ghar wapsi aur dil ki halat ka zikr karti hai. Paigham ki is pehli mulaqat ko baad ki risalat se alag nahi parhna chahiye.
pages.english:
Sahih Bukhari places the beginning of revelation at age forty. The Messenger of Allah would withdraw to Hira for worship. The angel brought the command to recite, and the opening verses of Al-Alaq were revealed.

Revelation began with the angel's message in Hira. The report describes his return home and concern. This first encounter opens the mission that the following chapters trace.

pages.title: Khadija ki tasalli
pages.roman:
Pehli wahi ke is waqie mein Khadija ki tasalli bhi samne aati hai. Pehli wahi ke baad aap Khadija ke paas lote. Unhon ne aapke nek akhlaq, rishtedaron ki madad aur zarooratmandon ka saath dene ko yaad dilakar tasalli di.

Khadija Radiyallahu Anha ne aap ﷺ ke husn-e-akhlaq aur doosron ki madad ka zikr karke tasalli di. Woh aap ﷺ ko Waraqa ke paas le gayin. Ghar ki yeh himayat pehli wahi ke waqie ki seedhi agli kadi hai.
pages.english:
After the first revelation, Khadija reassured him by recalling his care for relatives, the needy, guests and those in difficulty.

Khadija Radiyallahu Anha reassured him by recalling his care for others and good character, then took him to Waraqa. This support at home directly continues the first revelation account.
pages.titleEnglish: The Reassurance of Khadija Radiyallahu Anha

pages.title: Uthkar khabardar karna
pages.roman:
Wahi ke saath paigham pahunchane ki zimmedari thi. Allah Ta'ala ne uthkar khabardar karne, apne Rabb ki barai bayan karne aur pakizgi ki hidayat di. Rishtedaron ko bhi khabardar karne ka hukm aaya.

Ab paigham ko doosron tak pahunchane ki zimmedari samne thi. Apne qareebi rishtedaron ko khabardar karne ki hidayat bhi aayi. Aap ﷺ ki zindagi ka yeh mor zaati ibadat se aage qaum ko dawat dene ki zahir zimmedari ko samne lata hai.
pages.english:
Allah commanded him to arise and warn, magnify his Lord and maintain purity. He was also instructed to warn his close relatives.

The responsibility now included openly warning others, including close relatives. The account turns towards public mission and the duty to convey the message to the people.

pages.title: Mushkil mein sabr
pages.roman:
Dawat ki mushkil mein sabr ki rehnumai bhi mili. Allah Ta'ala ne apne Rasool ko pichhle rasoolon ki tarah sabr ki hidayat di. Aapka kaam paigham pahunchana tha; dilon ki hidayat Allah Ta'ala ke ikhtiyar mein hai.

Dawat ke rasta mein inkar aur gham bhi aaye. Quran ne mazboot irade wale Rasoolon jaisa sabr yaad dilaya aur wazeh kiya ke hidayat dena Allah Ta'ala ka ikhtiyar hai. Paigham pahunchana zimmedari thi; har shakhs ka iman lana aap ﷺ ke qabze mein nahi tha.
pages.english:
Allah instructed His Messenger to be patient like earlier messengers. His duty was to convey the message; ultimate guidance belongs to Allah.

Rejection and grief accompanied the mission. The Quran called for patience and clarified that guidance belongs to Allah. Conveying the message did not place every person's acceptance under the Prophet's control.

pages.title: Isra ka waqia
pages.roman:
Quran raat ke ek khaas safar ka bhi zikr karta hai. Allah Ta'ala ne apne bande ko raat mein Masjid al-Haram se Masjid al-Aqsa tak safar karaya, taake apni nishaniyan dikhaye.

Quran raat ke safar ko Allah Ta'ala ki nishaniyon ke dikhaye jane se jorta hai. Masjid-e-Haram se Masjid-e-Aqsa tak ka zikr is ayat ka markaz hai. Yahan us se bahar ke manazir apni taraf se shamil nahi kiye gaye.
pages.english:
Allah took His servant by night from the Sacred Mosque to the Farthest Mosque to show His signs.

The verse connects the night journey from the Sacred Mosque to the Farthest Mosque with showing Allah's signs. This chapter stays within that cited passage rather than supplying additional imagined scenes.

pages.title: Hijrat mein ghaar ki hifazat
pages.roman:
Hijrat ka waqia Allah Ta'ala ki madad ka ek aur manzar hai. Ghaar mein do saathiyon ke waqia ko Quran yaad dilata hai. Rasool Allah Ta'ala ﷺ ne saathi ko gham na karne aur Allah Ta'ala ke saath hone ki tasalli di.

Ghār mein saathi ko tasalli dene aur Allah Ta'ala ki madad ka zikr aata hai. Khauf ke is lamhe mein hifazat ka bharosa Allah Ta'ala par tha.
pages.english: The Quran recalls the two companions in the cave, where the Messenger reassured his companion that Allah was with them. The passage recalls reassurance to the companion in the cave and Allah's help. Trust in Allah stands at the centre.
pages.noteRoman: Hijrat ki kahani ko jaali, ghonsle ya ghair-sabit nishani ki tafseel se nahi bhara gaya.
pages.noteEnglish: Unverified details about webs or nests are not added.
pages.titleEnglish: Protection in the Cave During Migration

pages.title: Madinah mein bhai-chara
pages.roman:
Madinah mein muhajireen aur ansar ka rishta samne aaya. Quran pehle hijrat karne walon aur unki madad karne walon ki tareef karta hai. Ansar ne muhajireen se muhabbat aur apni zaroorat ke bawajood unhein tarjeeh di.

Muhajirin ko apne ghar chhorne pade aur Ansar ne unki madad ki. Quran apni zarurat ke bawajood doosron ko tarjeeh dene ka zikr karta hai. Hijrat ke baad nayi basti ka rishta sirf rehne ki jagah ka nahi, imani bhai-chare ka tha.
pages.english:
The Quran honours the early emigrants and their helpers. The Ansar loved the emigrants and preferred them even when themselves in need.

The emigrants left their homes and the Ansar supported them. The Quran praises giving preference to others despite need. The new community was joined by faith and mutual care, not residence alone.

pages.title: Badr mein madad
pages.roman:
Badr ke mauqe par momineen kamzor halat mein the. Quran unhein us waqt Allah Ta'ala ki madad yaad dilata hai. Madad ko shukr aur taqwa ke saath jora gaya.

Badr mein kamzori ki halat ke bawajood Allah Ta'ala ki madad mili. Farishton ki madad ka zikr dilon ke itminan se jora gaya aur asal fatah Allah Ta'ala ki taraf se batayi gayi. Is waqie ko apni quwwat par ghuroor ka sabab nahi banaya gaya.
pages.english:
The Quran recalls Allah’s help at Badr when the believers were weak, calling them to gratitude and mindfulness of Him.

Help came at Badr despite weakness. The mention of angels brought reassurance, while victory itself was attributed to Allah. The event was not a reason for pride in human power.

pages.title: Uhud ki azmaish
pages.roman:
Uhud mein ek sakht azmaish aur uski rehnumai samne aayi. Uhud ke waqia mein Quran Allah Ta'ala ke hukm, sabr aur itaat ki ahmiyat samjhata hai. Ghalati aur mushkil ke baad bhi Allah Ta'ala ki maafi aur rahmat ka zikr hai.

Uhud ke waqie mein hukm ke muamle mein ikhtilaf aur dunyawi raghbat ka zikr milta hai. Takleef ke saath maafi ka bayan bhi hai. Badr ki madad ke baad yeh hissa zimmedari aur ita-at ki ahmiyat ko yaad dilata hai.
pages.english:
The account of Uhud teaches obedience and steadfastness. Alongside mistakes and hardship, the Quran speaks of Allah’s pardon and mercy.

The Uhud passage mentions disagreement over instructions and desire for worldly gain, alongside suffering and forgiveness. Following Badr, it emphasises the continuing responsibility of obedience.

pages.title: Khandaq ke dino mein azmaish
pages.roman:
Ahzab ke waqt momineen ek sakht azmaish se guzre.

Allah Ta'ala ne hawa aur aise lashkar bheje jo nazar na aaye. Quran is nemat ko yaad dilata hai.

Girohon ke gherao ne sakht khauf aur azmaish paida ki. Quran hawa aur nazar na aane wale lashkaron se madad ka zikr karta hai. Is bayan mein mominon ka imtihan aur Allah Ta'ala ki madad dono saath samne aate hain.
pages.english:
During the siege by the confederates, the believers were severely tested. Allah sent wind and forces they did not see.

The siege brought fear and severe trial. The Quran mentions help through wind and unseen forces. The account preserves both the believers' ordeal and Allah's assistance.

pages.title: Sulh aur khuli fatah
pages.roman:
Surah Al-Fath ek aham marhale ki taraf tawajjuh dilati hai. Surah Al-Fath mein khuli fatah aur darakht ke neeche bayat karne walon par Allah Ta'ala ki raza ka zikr hai. Sabr aur aman ke muahide ka yeh aham marhala tha.

Sulh ke daur ko Quran ne khuli fatah kaha. Zahiri taur par jo waqt mushkil lag sakta tha, uske saath sukoon, razamandi aur aane wali nematon ka paigham tha. Baat sirf foran nazar aane wale faide tak mahdood nahi thi.
pages.english:
Surah Al-Fath announces a clear victory and Allah’s pleasure with those who pledged beneath the tree, an important stage of steadfastness and peace.

The period of treaty is described as a clear opening. Reassurance and promise accompanied a difficult situation. The account looks beyond immediate appearances towards Allah's favour and guidance.
pages.titleEnglish: A Treaty and a Clear Victory

pages.title: Makkah ki fatah aur tawazu
pages.roman:
Fatah ke saath Quran tawazu aur istighfar sikhata hai. Jab Allah Ta'ala ki madad aur fatah aaye aur log girohon mein deen mein dakhil hon, Quran Rabb ki tasbeeh, hamd aur maghfirat ki hidayat deta hai.

Fatah ke zikr ke baad Surah An-Nasr tasbeeh aur istighfar ki hidayat deti hai. Kamyabi ko takabbur mein badalne ke bajaye Rabb ki hamd aur maghfirat ki taraf rujoo hota hai. Makkah se jurti kahani ka yeh mor bandagi ko aur numayan karta hai.
pages.english:
When Allah’s help and victory come and people enter the religion in crowds, the Quran commands praise and seeking forgiveness.

Surah An-Nasr follows the mention of victory with glorification and seeking forgiveness. Success leads to worship rather than arrogance. This turn in the account of Makkah places humility at its centre.
pages.titleEnglish: The Conquest of Makkah and Humility

pages.title: Deen ki takmeel
pages.roman:
Quran mein deen mukammal karne aur nemat poori karne ka elan aaya. Sahih Bukhari batati hai ke yeh ayat Jumuah ke din Arafat mein nazil hui.

Deen ki takmeel ki ayat aur sahih riwayat uski ahmiyat ko samne lati hain. Is nemat ka taalluq Allah Ta'ala ki razamandi aur Islam se hai. Aage aap ﷺ ke akhlaq aur paigham ki pairwi hi ummat ki zimmedari rehti hai.
pages.english:
The Quran announces the completion of religion and Allah’s favour. Sahih Bukhari reports that this verse was revealed on a Friday at Arafat.

The verse on the completion of religion and the sahih report highlight the gift of Allah's favour and Islam. The continuing responsibility is to follow the guidance conveyed by the Prophet ﷺ.

pages.title: Rahmat aur behtareen misaal
pages.roman:
In waqiat ke saath aapki rehnumai ki pehchan bhi Quran batata hai. Allah Ta'ala ne Muhammad ﷺ ko jahanon ke liye rahmat banaya aur momineen ke liye aapki zindagi mein behtareen misaal batayi. Aapke akhlaq ki Quran tareef karta hai.

Quran aap ﷺ ko rahmat aur mominon ke liye behtareen misaal ke taur par pesh karta hai. Yeh tareef sirf parhne ke liye nahi, apne rawaiye aur amal ko dekhne ki dawat bhi hai. Kahani ke waqiat isi rehnumai ke saath jurte hain.
pages.english:
Allah sent Muhammad ﷺ as mercy to the worlds and made him an excellent example for believers. The Quran praises his great character.

The Quran presents the Prophet ﷺ as mercy and an excellent example. These descriptions call the reader towards conduct and practice. The events of the story are connected through that guidance.

pages.title: Wafat aur paigham ka baqi rehna
pages.roman:
Phir Rasool Allah Ta'ala ﷺ ki wafat ka waqt aaya. Sahih Bukhari ke mutabiq aapki wafat tirsath saal ki umar mein hui.

Rasool Allah Ta'ala ﷺ ki wafat ke baad Abu Bakr ne Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat aur Muhammad ﷺ ke Allah Ta'ala ke rasool hone ki yaad dilayi. Unhon ne Surah Aal-e-Imran ki ayat parhi.

Wafat ke baad Abu Bakr Radiyallahu Anhu ne logon ko yaad dilaya ke Allah Ta'ala hamesha zinda hai. Aap ﷺ ki bandagi karna maqsad nahi tha; aap ﷺ ka laya hua paigham Allah Ta'ala ki ibadat tha. Gham ke is waqt mein bhi tawheed ki hidayat barqarar rahi.
pages.english:
Sahih Bukhari reports his death at age sixty-three. After the Messenger’s death, Abu Bakr reminded the people to worship Allah and recited the verse affirming Muhammad ﷺ’s messengership and the mortality of messengers.

After his death, Abu Bakr Radiyallahu Anhu reminded the people that Allah is ever-living. The message had called them to worship Allah, not the Messenger. That guidance remained through their grief.
pages.titleEnglish: His Passing and the Lasting Message

books.birthNoteEnglish: The Quran recalls his orphanhood. This book does not assert an exact birth date; established reports of revelation and later life follow.
books.teaser: Muhammad ﷺ ki zindagi ke yeh marhale pehli wahi se dawat, hijrat aur deen ki takmeel tak pahunchte hain.
books.openingRoman: Muhammad ﷺ ki zindagi ke yeh marhale pehli wahi se dawat, hijrat aur deen ki takmeel tak pahunchte hain. Quran aur sahih hadees ki roshni mein rehmat, sabr aur Allah Ta'ala ki taraf bulane ka paigham parhein.
books.openingEnglish: These episodes from the life of Muhammad ﷺ extend from the first revelation to the mission, migration and completion of the religion. They present mercy, patience and the call to Allah through Quranic passages and authentic hadith.

editorialPolicy.basis: Quran and cited Sahih al-Bukhari / Sahih Muslim narrations
editorialPolicy.format: Original sourced retellings, not quotations from a modern translation
editorialPolicy.historicalOrder: Chapter order is for reading continuity; chronology is not asserted where the sources do not establish it.
editorialPolicy.referenceWork: Ibn Kathir, Qasas al-Anbiya (background structure only; unverified reports are excluded)
